title: E-Commerce Backoffice Assistant – Listings & Product Management
description:
About Us

We are Bluespoon GmbH, a fast-growing German e-commerce company specialising in premium tableware under our brand Sänger Geschirr. Our products are listed on Amazon, OTTO, Home24, Shopify, XXXLutz and more. Our team is based in Germany – you work remotely from the Philippines.

Our products can only be sold if they are correctly listed, fully populated and active across all channels. You make sure that is the case – every single day.



The Role

You are responsible for ensuring that our product data across all sales channels is complete, accurate and active. You create new listings, check existing ones for errors and policy violations, activate products after availability dates and support the build-out and maintenance of our growing product range.

This role is ideal for someone with a feel for e-commerce platforms, a structured working style and a genuine interest in how online product data works.



Your Responsibilities



- Create new product listings in JTL Wawi with all required master data: SKU, EAN, product name, category, price, weight, attributes

- Upload products and product data to Amazon and verify correct processing and visibility

- Activate and verify listings across all channels (Amazon, OTTO, Home24, Shopify, XXXLutz) after availability dates

- Monitor Amazon product listings daily for policy violations (e.g. broken variant families) – initiate corrections following documented processes

- Check Prime badge status weekly and resolve any missing badges

- Maintain B2B pricing rules on Amazon for all relevant products

- Reactivate listings after availability dates on all relevant platforms

- Support EPR compliance documentation at channel and product level

- Support OTTO Rich Content creation for product detail pages



Additional Backoffice Tasks:

- Monitor price changes in the pricing tool and verify transfer across all channels

- Create manual orders for B2B customers and influencers in JTL Wawi

- Coordinate weekly stock availability with the warehouse partner



What We Are Looking For



Must-Have:

- Structured, precise working style – you maintain data carefully and completely

- Good English skills (C1) – for internal communication and platform work

- Good Excel skills (data entry, formulas, structured input)

- Reliable and self-directed in executing recurring processes

- Stable internet connection, professional working environment

- Background in e-commerce, online retail or digital product management



Nice-to-Have:

- German language skills (strong plus – systems and documents are often in German)

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central – listings, variants, content, policies

- Knowledge of JTL Wawi or comparable ERP / warehouse management systems

- Understanding of marketplace logic (visibility, categories, attributes, compliance)





What We Offer

- Part-time remote position – work from the Philippines

- Long-term position with room to grow into more responsibilities

- Clearly documented processes – you will always know what comes next

- Direct collaboration with a professional German team



How to Apply



Please send us:

- Your CV / resume (in English)

- A short cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining why you are a good fit for this role

- A 1–2 minute intro video



Applications without all three items will not be considered.

yokes, and related simulator accessories — for the home and commercial flight simulation market.

Products are sold primarily through RealSimGear's Shopify storefront, serving a customer base that

ranges from individual hobbyists to enterprise and commercial simulator operators. As order and

support volume grows, RealSimGear is seeking a BPO partner to provide dedicated Tier 1 phone and

 support.



Key Responsibilities:

• Answer all inbound customer support phone calls within the coverage window described in Section 4, on the 1st or 2nd ring.

• Monitor and respond to inbound customer support
s throughout the coverage window.

• Identify each contact's support tier (Premium, Signature, or Standard) and prioritize handling accordingly, per Section 5.

• Perform Tier 1 troubleshooting and account/order support as described in Section 6.

• Create a ticket in HubSpot for every phone and
 contact, and apply the tagging scheme described in Section 6.

• Escalate issues outside Tier 1 scope to the appropriate internal RealSimGear resource per Section 8.



RealSimGear supports three customer tiers, in descending priority order:

• Premium – Enterprise-level accounts; highest priority for both phone and
.

• Signature – Mid-tier priority.

• Standard – Standard/default priority

Tier 1 Agent Responsibilities:

• Verify the customer's identity and look up account and order information in Shopify.

• Determine and confirm the customer's support tier in HubSpot.

• Provide order status, tracking, and shipping updates.

• Assist with basic account and login issues (e.g., password resets, account access).

• Answer general product-usage and basic troubleshooting questions using RealSimGear-provided

knowledge base and FAQ materials.

• Triage potential emergency or safety-related issues (e.g., a reported malfunction or safety hazard involving a motion simulator) and escalate immediately per Section 8.

• Create a HubSpot ticket for every phone and
 contact and apply, at minimum: Support Tier (Premium / Signature / Standard), Channel (Phone /
), Issue Category (Order Status, Account/Login, Product Troubleshooting, Emergency/Safety, Other), and Priority.

Out of Scope (Escalate to RealSimGear):

title: # Beauty Industry Research & Market Insights Analyst
description:
**The Online Beauty Warehouse**



The Online Beauty Warehouse is looking for a commercially minded **Research & Market Insights Analyst** to help us understand what is happening across the Australian professional beauty industry before it becomes obvious.



This is not a traditional SEO role and it is not simply about producing keyword reports.



We want someone who can combine **search behaviour, trend data, competitor research, customer behaviour and our own internal sales data** to identify what is growing, what is declining, what is emerging and what beauty businesses should be paying attention to.



Our goal is to build an ongoing proprietary intelligence platform around the Australian beauty industry and turn that research into genuinely useful information for salon, clinic, spa and beauty-business owners.



## What you'll be researching



You may investigate questions such as:



* Which beauty treatments are growing fastest in Australia?

* Which previously popular treatments are losing consumer interest?

* What terminology are consumers beginning to use?

* What treatments have strong "near me" search intent?

* What beauty categories are showing early signs of breakout growth?

* Which trends appear to be peaking?

* What are salon and clinic owners investing in?

* Which equipment categories are gaining or losing momentum?

* Are changes in consumer searches reflected in actual purchasing behaviour?

* Which Australian cities are showing the strongest demand for particular treatments?

* What are consumers asking about now that they weren't asking 12 months ago?



For example, rather than simply reporting that "lymphatic drainage is popular", we want to understand:



* current Australian search demand

* 12-month change

* three-year change

* geographical demand

* related emerging searches

* commercial-intent searches

* competing terminology

* seasonality

* TOBW website interest

* customer enquiries

* equipment and consumable sales



The objective is to turn multiple signals into useful commercial intelligence.



## Key responsibilities



* Conduct ongoing Australian beauty and wellness market research

* Analyse Google search behaviour and search-volume trends

* Use Google Trends to identify rising, declining and breakout categories

* Conduct detailed keyword and topic research

* Build groups of related search terms rather than relying on single keywords

* Monitor treatment, product and equipment categories over time

* Identify emerging terminology and changes in consumer language

* Analyse geographic differences across Australia

* Monitor competitor websites, product ranges and category expansion

* Track new beauty treatments, equipment and business models

* Analyse TOBW website, enquiry and sales data where provided

* Compare consumer search behaviour against actual B2B purchasing behaviour

* Maintain historical datasets so changes can be measured month to month and year to year

* Develop clear classifications such as **Breaking Out, Growing, Hot, Peaking, Cooling, Declining and Watch**

* Create charts, tables and summaries that make complex information easy to understand

* Identify interesting findings that could become reports, newsletters, articles or social content

* Assist with the annual Australian Beauty Business Survey

* Cross-analyse survey responses against search and transactional data

* Fact-check findings before publication

* Clearly distinguish correlation, consumer interest and actual commercial performance



## Tools you may use



Experience with some of the following would be highly regarded:



* Google Trends

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics / GA4

* Ubersuggest

* Semrush

* Ahrefs

* Google Keyword Planner

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Excel

* Looker Studio

* Data visualisation tools

* AI research and analysis tools



You do not need experience with every platform.



More important is your ability to **find the right information, question what the data actually means and identify commercially useful patterns.**



## What we're looking for



You will suit this role if you:



* enjoy research and finding patterns others miss

* are comfortable working with large amounts of information

* understand the difference between a trend and a temporary spike

* can interpret data rather than simply report numbers

* are naturally sceptical and check your conclusions

* understand search intent and consumer behaviour

* can explain data in plain English

* have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* are highly organised

* can maintain consistent datasets over long periods

* have excellent attention to detail

* can work independently and investigate a subject thoroughly

* are commercially minded and interested in why businesses make money



Experience in **beauty, aesthetics, wellness, hair, salon software, market research, SEO, e-commerce or business intelligence** would be advantageous but is not essential.



### To apply



Please send your resume along with a short explanation of your research or analytical experience.



As part of your application, please also provide **one example of a trend you believe is currently emerging or declining within beauty, aesthetics, hair or wellness, and briefly explain what evidence you would use to determine whether it is a genuine trend.**

Looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, and who understands the goal is a practical tool for a small soccer agency (not an enterprise system).

title: Shopify Customer Support Specialist — US/UK Supplement Brand ($1,000+/mo, Uncapped Bonuses, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT:

We're a US direct-to-consumer supplement brand running on Shopify. Our customers are mostly Americans and Brits aged 50+ who buy a premium heart-health product. We're profitable, scaling on paid ads, and we run a lean remote team — much of it already Filipino, and we've had excellent experiences.



We're hiring a Customer Support VA to handle our frontline inbox. You'll work from clear written SOPs, report to our Customer Support Manager, and become the voice of the brand to every customer who writes in.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Handle all inbound customer support 
-first, plus social DMs)

- Answer product, ingredient, dosage, and shipping questions using our written SOPs

- Process refunds, returns, and replacements according to policy

- Submit chargeback evidence in Disputify following our template

- Manage Shopify orders directly: address edits, cancellations, tracking problems, fulfillment escalations

- Handle international shipping questions with a tracking app and update based on internal shipping timelines.

- Follow a strict escalation script for any question that touches medication or medical advice to convert skeptical customers while minimizing legal liability

- Log activity in HubSpot, communicate daily in Slack

- Report weekly on your KPIs: first response time, ticket resolution time, etc



REQUIREMENTS — PLEASE DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE:

- Several years of hands-on Shopify experience. You know the admin panel cold: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer profiles. This is our hardest requirement and we verify it.

- Excellent written English. Your
s go straight to American and British customers with our brand name on them. Near-native written English is required, not preferred.

- Experience with a helpdesk platform — Gorgias, Zendesk, (especially Commslayer)

- Experience with HubStaff for employee time tracking

- You follow written SOPs exactly, every time, without needing to be re-taught

- Comfortable issuing refunds and handling disputes when relevant

- Fluent in Slack communication while being organized

- You know your KPIs and work to improve them

- Flexible around EST or GMT timezone

- Reliable internet, backup connection or power, quiet workspace



HOURS:

- Approximately 50 hours per week, 200 hours per month on average

- You can take a day or two off during the week, no problem just make the hours up on your other days. We care about hours delivered and results, not which day you sat down, unless otherwise noted or some unusual internal deadline is coming up.

- If we're understaffed and you want to earn more, you can request extra hours. We'd rather pay you than hire a second person.



PAY:

- Starting rate: $5.00 USD/hour — approximately $1,000 USD/month at 200 hours

- Performance bonuses on top, with no cap on earnings. Hit your KPIs consistently and your monthly total goes up. There is no ceiling here. This is especially true for churn-reduction, as we have paying customers on subscription. If you help save a customer from bailing, you can earn big, consistently, paid every month as a percentage of the customer lifetime value.

- Long-term role with a clear path — our Customer Support Manager position is the next step up, and we promote internally first.



BEFORE YOU START - COMPLETE BEFORE THE FIRST SHIFT:

- A short interview call with our founder. Quick and easy — we just want to hear you talk.

- Sign our agreements — employment contract, non-disclosure, and non-compete. Standard documents, sent digitally for e-signature.

- Install HubStaff on your work machine. Hours are tracked through it so we can make efficiency gains without micromanaging you.

- Complete our training courses — product knowledge, SOPs, tone of voice, and the medication escalation script. (Paid Training) 



Voila, now you are ready to start responding to tickets! We invest heavily in onboarding because we're hiring for the long term, not for a month. In return we expect you to take it seriously.



HOW TO APPLY:

Reply with the following. Applications missing any item WILL be skipped:

- Start your message with the word "Natto" so we know you read this in full

- Your Shopify experience — which store categories, what you did, how long

- Which helpdesk tools you have the most experience with and preference for, and why

- Your experience with refunds, chargebacks, and subscription cancellations

- Your available working hours in EST or GMT

- Your expected hourly rate



LASTLY:

Answer this scenario in 2–3 sentences. A 71-year-old customer
s: "I'm on blood thinners and my doctor didn't say anything specific about your heart health supplement. Can I take 2 capsules a day?" Write the exact reply you would send him.

title: Customer Support Manager (Retention, LTV, Chargebacks) US/UK Supplement Brand · $1,600/mo + Uncapped Growth Potential
description:
ABOUT US:

We're a US direct-to-consumer supplement brand running on Shopify. Our customers are mostly Americans and Brits aged 50+ who buy a premium heart-health product on subscription. We're profitable, scaling on paid ads, and we run a lean remote team — much of it already Filipino, and we've had excellent experiences.



We're hiring a Customer Support Manager to own retention. Read that carefully, because it changes what this job is. You are not here to close tickets — you're here to keep subscribers paying, raise their lifetime value, and train the support team to do the same, while keeping refunds and chargebacks on the floor.



This is a quasi-sales role. Every subscriber you save pays you a percentage of their lifetime value, every month, with no cap. The person who wants a comfortable salary will be bored here. The person who wants their income tied to numbers they control will do very well.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own our churn number. Loop Subscriptions cancel flows, pause and skip offers, downgrade paths, win-back sequences — you build them, test them, and report on them.

- Own LTV. Upgrade paths, bundle offers, subscription upsells at the right moment in the customer relationship. Growing an existing subscriber is cheaper than buying a new one, and that is your job.

- Own our Klaviyo lifecycle flows. Post-purchase, shipping, onboarding, results-expectation, pre-renewal, win-back. Our product works gradually, our guarantee has a window, and our shipping crosses borders — most of our tickets and most of our churn come from customers who were never told what to expect and when. You fix that upstream, in the flows, before it ever reaches the inbox.

- Keep refunds and chargebacks at a minimum — build the evidence packs, submit representments in Disputify, and fix the upstream reasons disputes happen in the first place.

- Manage and train our support reps on retention. They handle the frontline inbox; you make sure every one of them can hold a save conversation instead of processing a cancellation. Coaching, ticket reviews, QA.

- Write and maintain the SOPs the team runs on, including the medication escalation script

- Build and maintain our help center and macro library — kill the reasons tickets get opened, not just the tickets

- Handle escalations personally, including occasional voice calls with US/UK customers aged 50+

- Design AI-driven support workflows that cut ticket volume, prevent chargebacks, reduce churn, and lift LTV

- Own the weekly report to the founder: churn rate, save rate, LTV, refund rate, chargeback win rate, first response time, ticket resolution time



REQUIREMENTS — PLEASE DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE



- Hands-on Loop Subscriptions experience. You've built cancel flows, offers, and dunning inside Loop, not just clicked around it. Tell us what you built and what it moved.

- Hands-on Klaviyo experience building
/SMS flows — specifically flows that manage expectations around product results, guarantees, and shipping times. You understand that a well-timed "here's what week 3 feels like"
 is worth more than a hundred perfect ticket replies, and you can point to flows you built that cut tickets or churn.

- Demonstrated churn reduction and LTV growth. You have numbers. Before and after. If you can't put figures on your retention work, you're not the person for this role.

- You keep refunds and chargebacks low while doing it. Anyone can cut churn by never letting people leave. We want retention that doesn't come back as a dispute six weeks later.

- Experience managing and training support reps. You've coached people, run QA, and held a team to numbers.

- Several years of hands-on Shopify experience. Admin panel cold: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer profiles. We verify this.

- Excellent written English. Your
s go straight to American and British customers with our brand name on them. Near-native written English is required, not preferred.

- Comfortable on voice/phone calls with a neutral accent.
-first role, but retention saves and escalations sometimes happen live, with customers aged 50+, during normal business hours.

- Prior support experience in supplements, health, medical devices, or pharmacy. You understand where the line sits between explaining a label and giving medical advice, and you hold it under pressure.

- Chargeback evidence-pack construction — not just "I've used Disputify," but knowing what wins a representment: delivery confirmation, terms acceptance, communication logs, policy screenshots

- Experience building or maintaining a help center or macro library

- Experience with a helpdesk platform — Gorgias, Zendesk, especially Commslayer

- Experience with HubStaff for employee time tracking

- Flexible around EST or GMT timezone

- Reliable internet, backup connection or power, quiet workspace



HOURS



Approximately 50 hours per week, 200 hours per month on average

You can take a day or two off during the week, no problem — just make the hours up on your other days. We care about hours delivered and results, not which day you sat down, unless otherwise noted or some unusual internal deadline is coming up.

If we're understaffed and you want to earn more, you can request extra hours. We'd rather pay you than hire a second person.



PAY — READ THIS PART



Base: $8.00 USD/hour — approximately $1,600 USD/month at 200 hours

Plus a percentage of the lifetime value of every subscriber you save, paid monthly, with no cap. This is the real compensation. Our subscribers are long-term and our AOV is high, so a manager who moves churn a few points meaningfully changes their own income.

Additional performance bonuses on KPIs: chargeback win rate, refund rate, LTV growth

Long-term role. We're hiring someone to own this function completely as we scale, and to build the team under them.



BEFORE YOU START



Every hire completes these four steps before their first shift:



A short interview call with our founder. Quick and easy — we just want to hear you talk.

Sign our agreements — employment contract, non-disclosure, and non-compete. Standard documents, sent digitally for e-signature.

Install HubStaff on your work machine. Hours are tracked through it so we can make efficiency gains without micromanaging you.

Complete our training courses — product knowledge, SOPs, tone of voice, and the medication escalation script. (Paid)



Voila, now you're ready to start. We invest heavily in onboarding because we're hiring for the long term, not for a month. In return we expect you to take it seriously.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with the following. Applications missing any item WILL be skipped:



Start your message with the word "Natto" so we know you read this in full

Your Shopify experience — which store categories, what you did, how long

Your Loop Subscriptions experience — what you built inside it, and what happened to churn

Your Klaviyo experience — which flows you built, and what they did to ticket volume or churn. If you've built a results-expectation or shipping-expectation flow specifically, describe it.

Your best retention result with real numbers. Churn before, churn after, over what period, on what size subscriber base. What did you actually change?

How you kept refunds and chargebacks down while doing it

How many support reps you've managed and trained, and how you held them to numbers

Which helpdesk tools you have the most experience with and preference for, and why

Your available working hours in EST or GMT

Your expected hourly rate



Lastly, answer both of these:



In 2–3 sentences. A 71-year-old customer
s: "I'm on Blood Thinners and my Doctor didn't say anything specific about your heart health supplement. Can I take 2 capsules a day?" Write the exact reply you would send him.

In 4–6 sentences. A subscriber on month 3 writes: "I haven't noticed anything yet, please cancel my subscription." Write the exact reply you would send her.

I am looking for someone who is confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers. 



This is not just an appointment-setting role. 



I need someone who is comfortable asking for the sale and helping move prospects toward a signed agreement.



Experience selling to property managers, contractors, HOAs, commercial accounts, or local businesses is a strong advantage.

title: Junior SEO Specialist – Experienced / Strategic - Please answer questions below when applying.
description:
Please answer questions below when applying. 



We are looking for an **experienced Junior SEO Specialist** who understands SEO beyond simply completing monthly tasks.



You should be able to analyse a website, understand its commercial objectives, identify ranking opportunities and explain **what actions you would take to improve organic performance and why**.



This role is suited to someone who already has hands-on SEO experience and wants to continue developing their strategic capabilities.



## What We're Looking For



You should have practical experience across:



* Keyword research and keyword mapping

* Commercial keyword intent

* **BOFU (Bottom-of-Funnel) keyword strategy**

* On-page SEO

* Technical SEO fundamentals

* Service and location page optimisation

* Content strategy and optimisation

* Internal linking and website architecture

* Competitor and SERP analysis

* Link building and authority development

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar SEO tools

* Tracking keyword rankings, organic traffic and conversions



## Commercial SEO Understanding



A major part of this role is understanding that **not every keyword has the same commercial value**.



You should understand the difference between:



**Informational keywords** — users researching or learning about a topic.



**Commercial / BOFU keywords** — users actively searching for a service, product or provider and are much closer to converting.



You should be able to look at a business and determine:



**Which keywords are most likely to generate actual enquiries and revenue?**



We want someone who can prioritise SEO opportunities based on **commercial impact**, not simply search volume.



## Strategic SEO Thinking



If you're given a website that isn't performing, you should be able to investigate:



* What is currently ranking?

* What isn't ranking?

* Which keywords should the business be targeting?

* What are competitors doing better?

* Does the website properly match search intent?

* Are the correct pages targeting the correct keywords?

* Are there content gaps?

* Are pages competing against each other?

* Are there technical problems?

* Is the internal linking structure strong enough?

* Does the website have enough authority?

* What actions should be prioritised first?



Most importantly, you should be able to explain **why you would take each action**.



## Interview Requirement – Show Us Two Websites



As part of the interview, we will ask you to present **two websites you have personally worked on and helped improve through SEO**.



For each website, be prepared to explain:



### 1. Where It Started



What was the website's organic position when you became involved?



What were the main problems you identified?



### 2. Keyword Strategy



What keywords did you target?



Which keywords had the strongest commercial intent?



Which were **BOFU keywords** and why were they important to the business?



### 3. What You Actually Did



Walk us through the actions you personally took.



For example:



* Keyword research

* Keyword mapping

* Service page optimisation

* Creation of new landing pages

* Content improvements

* Technical fixes

* Internal linking

* Site structure improvements

* Competitor gap analysis

* Link building

* Outreach

* Backlink acquisition



Don't simply tell us what was done — **explain why you d
 to do it.**



### 4. What Happened Over 3–6 Months?



Show us the impact your work had.



Where possible, demonstrate:



* Starting keyword positions

* Current keyword positions

* Movement into Page 1 / Top 10

* Top 3 rankings

* Organic traffic growth

* Search Console improvements

* Organic conversions or enquiries

* Improvements in commercially valuable keywords



We want to understand the journey:



**Starting Position ? Analysis ? Strategy ? Actions ? Ranking Improvement**



## Example of the Thinking We're Looking For



Rather than:



*"We wrote blogs, optimised pages and built backlinks."*



We want someone who can explain:



*"The website was ranking around position 15 for an important commercial keyword. After reviewing the SERP and competitors, I identified that the service page didn't properly satisfy search intent and lacked supporting authority.*



*I improved the page structure and content, strengthened internal links from relevant pages, addressed technical/on-page issues and built relevant backlinks to the page.*



*Over the following 3–6 months, the keyword moved onto Page 1 and organic enquiries increased."*



That shows us you understand **what happened, why you took action and how those actions contributed to the result.**



## What Success Looks Like



You don't need to know everything, but you must be able to **think strategically about SEO**.



We're looking for someone who can demonstrate:



**Commercial Intent ? Opportunity ? Strategy ? Action ? Result**



You should be curious, analytical and comfortable investigating why a website isn't ranking rather than simply following an SEO checklist.



### To Apply



Please provide **two websites you have personally worked on and helped rank**.



For each website, briefly include:



* The website

* Your involvement

* Important keywords targeted

* What you changed

* How long you worked on it

* Results achieved within approximately 3–6 months



Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss these examples in detail during the interview.

You'll plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across ecommerce channels, driving profitable growth for our toy & game brand clients.



We live by FUN, UPBEAT, EFFICIENT, and LIMITLESS. You'll see that in how we work and how we treat every client's ad spend like it's our own.

title: Executive Operations & Business Growth Manager
description:
This Is Not Your Typical Virtual Assistant Role



We are not looking for someone who simply completes tasks.



We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner — someone who sees inefficiencies, identifies opportunities, solves problems and constantly looks for ways to make a business more efficient, scalable and profitable.



You should naturally ask:

“Is there a better way to do this?”

“Can this be automated?”

“Can AI do this?”

“How can we scale this without simply adding more people?”



If that sounds like you, please keep reading.



About Us

We are a growing UK-based property company specializing in short-term accommodation.

As we grow, we are continually improving our systems, processes and technology. We are looking for an Executive Operations & Business Growth Manager to work closely with the founder and help take the business to its next stage.



This is a role for someone who wants responsibility, ownership and the opportunity to genuinely influence how a business operates and grows.



The Role

Your role will combine business operations, process improvement, project management, AI and automation.



You will be expected to:

- Help oversee and improve daily business operations

- Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks and areas for improvement

- Develop and improve systems, workflows and SOPs

- Research and implement software and technology

- Manage projects from idea through to completion

- Coordinate team members and ensure accountability

- Research new business opportunities

- Find ways to reduce unnecessary work and costs

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes

- Use AI to improve productivity, decision-making and business operations

- Help build systems that allow the business to scale without increasing workload at the same rate



We don't want someone who simply tells us what is wrong.

We want someone who can say:



“Here is the problem, here is what I recommend, here is how we can implement it, and here is how we can measure whether it worked.”



AI & Automation

AI will be a major part of this role.



You do not need to be a developer, but you should have strong practical knowledge of modern AI tools and understand how they can be applied within a real business.



We want someone who can use AI to:

- Automate repetitive work

- Improve workflows

- Analyse information and data

- Research opportunities

- Create systems and documentation

- Improve communication

- Reduce administrative workload

- Identify opportunities for further automation



We are particularly interested in someone who understands how to integrate AI into business processes, rather than someone who simply knows how to use ChatGPT.



Please include “Always Improving” at the very top of your application so we know you have read the advert carefully.



The Person We Are Looking For



You are someone who:

- Thinks commercially and strategically

- Takes ownership without needing constant direction

- Understands how businesses can scale

- Has strong operations experience

- Loves solving problems

- Is highly organised and analytical

- Thinks ahead and anticipates problems

- Is confident researching and implementing new technology

- Has strong practical AI knowledge

- Looks for opportunities to automate and improve

- Can challenge inefficient processes constructively

- Communicates exceptionally well

- Turns ideas into action



Most importantly, you don't just ask what needs to be done — you ask whether there is a better way to do it.



Essential Requirements

- Minimum 3 years' experience in operations, business management, project management, executive support or similar

- Strong understanding of business operations and process improvement

- Demonstrated ability to improve systems or workflows

- Strong practical knowledge of AI tools

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong organisational and project management skills

- Experience with Google Workspace and project management software

- Ability to work independently and take ownership

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

- Reliable internet connection and quiet home office



Bonus Experience

Experience with AI automation, AI agents, property/hospitality, Airbnb, Hostfully, PriceLabs, team leadership, SOP development or business scaling is highly advantageous.



Salary

Competitive and based on experience.



We are looking for the right person, not simply the lowest hourly rate.

Exceptional performance will be recognised through increased responsibility, salary increases and performance-based bonuses.



Application Questions

Please answer these with specific examples, rather than generic answers.

1. Tell us about a process you improved. What was wrong with it, what did you change, and what was the result?

2. Tell us about a time you identified a problem or opportunity before anyone else noticed it. What did you do?

3. Which AI tools do you currently use? Give us a specific example of how you have used AI to save time, automate work or improve a business process.

4. Imagine you discover that a team is spending 10 hours every week doing a repetitive manual task. How would you approach finding a better solution?

5. If you joined our business tomorrow, what would you want to understand or analyse during your first 30 days?

6. Why do you believe you would be good at helping a business scale and continuously improve, rather than simply managing its existing operations?



Video

Please record a 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be an excellent fit for this role.



Please note: Applications that do not meet the essential requirements outlined above, including the required 2–3 minute video introduction, may not be considered for the next stage of the recruitment process. We encourage you to apply only if your experience, skills and approach closely align with what we are looking for.

We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————

**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.

Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.

Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: UGC Manager (Full-Time, Long-Term) - Swedish Menswear Brand
description:
ABOUT US



We are a Swedish menswear brand run by two founders, full-time for two years. No logos, honest pricing, real materials: wool, linen, cotton. Quiet luxury without the logo tax. We sell direct across Europe and the UK aswell worldwide and we grow almost entirely on creator content.



THE ROLE



Employment type: Full-time, 40 hours per week, 100% remote

Compensation: $1,000 to $1,200 USD per month, depending on experience

Reports to: Co-founder

Level: Manager, department owner



This is not a junior coordinator, a virtual assistant, or a basic influencer outreach position. You will not be posting to our feed or answering customer
s.



Creator content is the single channel this company grows on, and it has outgrown the two founders running it on the side. We are hiring one person to own it, and not someone who needs to be told every step. We want someone who can take the pipeline as it is today, see what is broken in it, and build it into something that runs.



YOUR MISSION



Turn a steady flow of the right creators into a steady flow of ads that sell. You own:



- Creator sourcing and daily outreach on Instagram and TikTok

- Qualification against our fit checklist: 10k+ followers or reels that regularly clear 20k views, 2%+ engagement, men 18 to 45, EU/UK/Nordic, smart-casual

- Every reply after first contact: rates, negotiation, terms, confirmation. Nothing sits past 48 hours

- Product seeding end to end, from raising the Shopify order to chasing what is stuck

- Briefs, reference videos and deadlines, holding a 7-day turnaround from the day product arrives

- Content review against the brief, reshoot requests, and collecting the ad code for our media buyers

- D
 which creators are worth upgrading to a retainer and which to cut

- Keeping the pipeline current so anyone can see its true state without asking you



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- 1+ years managing UGC creators or influencer partnerships for a DTC or ecommerce brand

- Proven with gifted and seeded deals, not only paid ones. Getting a creator to film for product is a core skill here

- Comfortable with high daily outreach volume, and with people not replying

- Genuinely organised. 30+ active creators takes systems, not memory

- Written English that sounds like a person who watched their content, not a template

- Taste: you can tell content that stops the scroll from content that merely looks nice

- Warm with creators, firm when work is late or off-brief

- Full-time, reliably overlapping European hours, looking for a long-term home



Fashion or menswear experience is a plus, not a requirement. So is familiarity with Meta Partnership Ads and TikTok Spark Ads.



WHAT THIS ROLE HAS THAT OTHERS DO NOT



- A real system, not a spreadsheet. We built our own dashboard, the Command Center, which holds the whole creator pipeline: who was contacted, what stage they are at, what is owed, what is overdue. Most jobs like this fall apart at 40 creators. Yours will not.

- Direct access to the founders. No middle management. Bring an idea on Monday, get a decision on Monday.

- We are AI-forward and we mean it. If you already reach for AI to move faster, there is room here.

- Ask for the tool that makes you faster and we buy it.

- This seat is the lead of our Content Engine. Creators, editors and outreach support sit under it as we scale.



COMPENSATION



$1,000 to $1,200 USD per month, plus a performance bonus tied to content delivered and creators converted. Strong candidates start at $1,000 with a written review at 90 days that moves them to the top of the band.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow this exactly. It takes about 15 minutes and it is how we find the people who actually read.



1. Begin your application with this exact line: "I own the pipeline."

2. Your relevant experience: which brands, how many creators, what you personally handled, and what came of it.

3. Find one creator on Instagram or TikTok who fits a Swedish menswear brand selling to men 18 to 45 in Europe. Paste the link and two sentences on why they would convert for us.

4. Write the exact DM you would send that creator: free product in exchange for a video we can run as a Meta ad.

5. Tell us how you would handle a creator who received the product, missed the deadline by a week, and stopped replying.

title: Property Management Operations Assistant | Australian Real Estate
description:
Monarch Estate Agents is a Melbourne-based property business looking for an experienced Property Management Operations Assistant to become a reliable extension of our team.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role supporting the day-to-day operations of our property management portfolio.



We’re looking for someone who moves quickly, communicates exceptionally well, notices the small details and keeps everyone updated without needing to be asked.



What you’ll be doing —



You’ll support our team across:



* Maintenance requests and contractor coordination

* Calling and communicating with trades, renters and rental providers

* Obtaining and following up quotes

* Rental arrears and follow-ups

* Lease renewals

* Rental application screening and summaries

* Routine inspection scheduling

* PropertyMe records and task management

*
s, documentation and general administration

* Daily task tracking, follow-ups and progress summaries



What matters to us —



1. Communication



You need to be confident communicating by both phone and
 with trades, renters and rental providers.



We want someone who can have a conversation, understand what’s happening, take clear notes and communicate the important information back to the team.



2. Proactivity



Don’t wait for someone to ask:



“Where is this up to?”



If you’ve finished your current task, check what’s outstanding and move onto the next priority.



If something is waiting on another person, follow it up.



If something needs attention, flag it.



And keep the team updated as you go.



3. Speed



Property management moves quickly.



We’re looking for someone who can understand a task, take action and work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



4. Attention to detail



The small things matter.



Was the correct photo uploaded?



Is the PropertyMe record accurate?



Does the write-up make sense?



Is important information missing?



Has the follow-up actually been scheduled?



We want someone who naturally checks their work before considering something complete.



5. Ownership



A task isn’t finished because an
 was sent.



It’s finished when the outcome has been followed through, the records are correct and the relevant people know where things stand.



You’ll be a strong fit if you:



* Have previous experience with Australian property management

* Have strong working knowledge of PropertyMe

* Understand maintenance, arrears, renewals, applications and inspections

* Have excellent spoken and written English

* Are confident speaking with trades, renters and rental providers

* Work quickly and independently

* Take clear, useful notes

* Proactively provide updates and task summaries

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Can manage multiple priorities without needing constant direction

* Have reliable internet and a professional home-office setup



The position—



* Full-time, Monday–Friday

* Remote

* Working in alignment with Melbourne business hours

* Long-term position

* Training provided on Monarch’s specific processes

* Opportunity to grow with the agency



We’re not looking for a long, generic cover letter.



And please don’t send us an AI-generated essay telling us you’re a “detail-oriented, proactive self-starter.”



We’d rather meet the actual person.



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short overview of your Australian property management experience

3. Your experience with PropertyMe

4. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary

5. Your availability during Melbourne business hours

6. A link to a 2–3 minute Loom video answering:



Why did this particular role stand out to you?



What experience do you have that would make you genuinely useful to Monarch?



And one personal question: What is something you genuinely enjoy outside of work?



There is no correct answer to the last question. We just want to know a little about the person behind the application.



What happens next?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical trial of approximately one hour, using tasks similar to the work you’ll actually be doing at Monarch.



We’ll be looking at how you communicate, prioritise, work through information, catch details and get things done.



The strongest applicants will then progress to a final interview.



Start your application with the word “MONARCH” so we know you’ve read the full listing.



If this sounds like the way you naturally work, we’d love to hear from you.

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via
, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SPECIALIST
description:

Penji is looking for a relentless Business Development Specialist to take ownership of high-volume prospecting and help our Partnerships Team build valuable relationships with affiliates, sponsors, media, and strategic partners.



This isn’t a role for someone who waits for leads to come in.

You hunt. You test. You follow up. You adapt. You close the meeting.



If one approach doesn’t work, you find another. If a message gets ignored, you test a better one. If you love the challenge of improving response and conversion rates, this could be the role for you.



ABOUT PENJI

Since 2017, Penji has provided on-demand access to top-tier graphic designers through a subscription-based creative service.

We’ve been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S.

Design is what we do. Making a difference is who we strive to be.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your responsibilities will include:

• Execute high-volume, multi-channel outreach through
, LinkedIn, phone, video, and other available channels 

• Research and build highly targeted prospect lists 

• Identify key decision-makers and high-value partnership opportunities 

• Create and test different outreach messages, approaches, and follow-up strategies 

• Consistently work toward and achieve monthly meeting-booking targets 

• Follow up persistently until an opportunity converts—or is genuinely exhausted 

• Keep prospect information and activities organized in the CRM 

• Track your own performance, including response rates, conversion rates, and channel effectiveness 

• Continuously experiment with messaging, timing, and outreach channels to improve results 

• Work closely with the Partnerships Team to understand what makes a prospect a qualified opportunity 



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who can prove they can generate results, not just someone who has experience sending outreach messages.



You should have:

• 2+ years of experience in outreach, business development, lead generation, or sales 

• A proven track record of meeting or exceeding appointment/meeting-booking targets 

• Experience with multiple outreach channels, including
, LinkedIn, phone, and/or video 

• Strong prospect research and lead qualification skills 

• Excellent written and verbal English communication 

• Strong persistence and resilience when dealing with rejection 

• A results-driven and quota-oriented mindset 

• Ability to identify what isn't working and quickly adjust your strategy 

• Experience using CRMs and outreach automation tools 

• Strong organizational and follow-up skills 

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment 



BIG PLUS IF YOU HAVE:

• Experience with B2B partnerships or business development 

• Experience booking meetings with decision-makers 

• Experience with affiliate, sponsorship, media, or strategic partnership outreach 

• Experience using tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Instantly, Smartlead, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or Zoho 

• A portfolio, report, or track record showing your outreach numbers and conversion results 



COMPENSATION

Base: $300–$1,000+ USD/month

Compensation depends on experience, performance, and results, with additional commission and performance-based earning potential.

If you're motivated by results and want your earning potential to reflect your performance, this role gives you room to grow.



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF...

You enjoy the chase.

You don't get discouraged by rejection.

You know that one unanswered message doesn't mean the opportunity is dead.

You look at numbers and ask:

“How can I improve this conversion rate?”

You don't need someone constantly telling you what to do.

You see a target, build a strategy, execute, measure the results, and keep improving.

If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.



Apply now and show us what you can do.

title: BD Manager - Crypto DeFi Partnerships (Uncapped Bonuses)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

D. $250 partnership bonus when a partnership you originated or materially managed goes live AND at least $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). An announcement or deployment with no qualifying mints does not pay

E. Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

F. No cap on appointment bonuses. One bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

G. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

H. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: AU Senior Tax Accountant / Team Leader (Xero, Karbon, Xero Tax)
description:
AU Senior Tax Accountant / Team Leader | QC Accountants (Gold Coast, Australia) | Permanent, work from home



PHP 150,
,000 per month | Full time, 38 hours | Australian Eastern Standard Time



About us

QC Accountants is a Chartered Accounting and business advisory practice at Varsity Lakes on the Gold Coast. We are a Xero Gold Partner and a CA ANZ member firm, and we look after private business groups, family trusts, companies and self-managed super funds across Australia. Our website is 
.



Our Philippine team is six people, growing to around ten. We are hiring the person who will lead it.



The role

You will be the first point of contact for the Philippine team and the first person to review its work. Every job the team prepares passes through you before it reaches our Australian reviewer.



About half the week is review and leadership. The other half is your own client files - group financial statements, general purpose financial statements, and the more complex jobs the Director allocates to you directly.



Anything carrying a technical position goes to our Australian reviewer or to the Director. We will show you exactly where that line sits in your first week.



What you will do

Review and leadership:

- Review every file the team prepares before it goes to Australian review - year-end workpapers, financial statements, BAS and IAS

- Complete and sign our 40-item Trial Balance Review Checklist on each year-end job

- Check GST coding against our GST treatment cheatsheet, with attention to overseas suppliers, entertainment, contractor ABN and GST registration, and private expenses sitting in the profit and loss

- Own the Philippine section of our Karbon job board, so every job carries a status, an owner and a due date

- Give the Director a short weekly report on jobs at risk, work in progress ageing and spare capacity

- Run a weekly team huddle, a monthly one-to-one with each accountant, and one technical session a month on whatever the review points are showing

- Keep our SOPs and checklists current, and train the team when they change



Your own client work:

- Prepare group financial statements, general purpose financial statements and income tax returns from start to finish

- Act as a second point of contact for the clients where the Director introduces you



What you will bring

- A degree in accounting, finance or commerce

- At least four years working on Australian clients, in an Australian public practice or in an offshore team serving one

- Australian company and trust financial statements and tax returns you have prepared yourself, start to finish

- Working knowledge of Division 7A, trust distributions, capital gains tax and GST, at a level that lets you find a problem in someone else's file

- Experience checking or reviewing work prepared by other accountants. Formal supervision counts, and so does being the senior everyone brings their questions to

- Advanced Xero, including the ability to trace a reconciliation problem back to its cause

- Clear written English. You will be
ing Australian clients and writing review notes the team has to act on

- A private home office, reliable fibre internet, and a plan for power outages



Desirable

CPA or CA. Xero Tax, Xero Workpapers, XPM, Karbon, NowInfinity, BGL 360, Class Super, QuickBooks Online. Experience with building and construction, NDIS, hospitality, ecommerce or property clients. Group consolidations.



What success looks like at six months

- Eight files in ten clear Australian review without a rework loop

- Every job reaches Australian review by its internal due date

- No BAS lodged late

- Every accountant on the team has a written development plan and knows what they are working on

- The reviewer's rework list is measurably shorter than it is today



What we offer

- PHP 150,
,000 per month depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days and then annually

- Permanent, long-term work from home, reporting to the same Australian leadership from day one

- Paid leave and Australian public holidays

- A written position description and KPI scorecard from the start, so the measures are clear

- Direct access to the Director, and a senior Australian reviewer who explains the reasoning behind every review point

- In-person team events. This year the team is going to Bali, and we hold our Christmas party in Australia



How to apply

Apply through this OnlineJobs.ph post, using the subject line: AU Tax Team Leader, [your surname]



Attach your CV and answer all six questions in your message. Short answers are fine, and please answer all of them - reviewing work is largely a matter of following written instructions carefully, so we do read for that.



1. How many Australian company and trust tax returns have you prepared yourself, from trial balance through to lodgement-ready, and in which years?

2. Which Australian tax software and workpaper software have you used, and for how long?

3. A client company lent its sole director A$80,000 during the year, and the loan is still outstanding at 30 June. Which provision applies, and what are two ways of dealing with it before lodgement day?

4. A junior sends you a BAS workpaper claiming 
 credits on a
 advertising invoice and on a restaurant bill. What do you tell them, and why?

5. Tell us about a time you found a material error in someone else's file. How did you find it, and how did you raise it?

6. What monthly rate are you looking for in PHP, and when could you start?



We read every application and reply through OnlineJobs.ph. We aim to shortlist within five working days.

title: Client Success Account Manager - $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.
