title: ONBOARDING MANAGER (Tech-Focused) - $900 p/m + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Customer Service Manager (Remote Opportunity)
description:
Customer Service Manager — DTC Brand

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Industry: DTC E-commerce



About the Role

We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand, and customer experience sits at the heart of everything we do. We're hiring an experienced Customer Service Manager to lead our support team, sharpen our systems, and keep our customers delighted as we scale.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You've managed support teams before — ideally larger teams at established DTC brands — and you know how to push a team to perform: coaching agents, holding them accountable, and driving results week over week. Experience in fashion, apparel, or other high-volume categories is a strong plus.



What You'll Own

Team leadership & motivation — This is the core of the role. You'll actively lead, push, and develop the support team to perform at a high level. That means:



- Running weekly team calls to align on priorities, review performance, and keep momentum

- Holding regular one-on-one coaching sessions to develop each agent and lift weak spots

- Setting clear expectations, holding the team accountable, and driving results — not just managing the day-to-day, but genuinely pushing performance higher

- Keeping the team motivated, focused, and consistently delivering excellent customer experiences



Refunds & exchanges — Own the refund and exchange processes and keep these rates trending down. You'll:

- Monitor refund and exchange rates closely and react fast when they spike — diagnosing the root cause and putting a plan in place to bring them back down

- Develop ongoing strategies to reduce unnecessary refunds and lower exchange rates while keeping customers happy

- Use a real understanding of customer behavior, policy, and internal workflows to fix problems at the source



Systems & tooling — Build efficient ticketing systems, workflows, and automation in platforms like Zendesk, Freshdesk, or Gorgias.



KPIs — Own and improve response time, resolution time, CSAT, and ticket-volume management, backed by clear tracking and reporting.



Performance reporting — Track agent productivity, resolution quality, and operational efficiency, and build the reporting that helps the team continuously improve.



What You Bring



- Proven experience managing customer support teams for DTC brands

- A leadership style that actively pushes, coaches, and develops agents to perform

- Comfort handling high ticket volumes

- Hands-on experience with support platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, or similar)

- A track record of KPI tracking and performance management



Bonus points for experience with fast-scaling DTC brands, fashion or apparel, or high-volume e-commerce.



You're Someone Who:

- Is highly organized and leads teams well

- Understands customer behavior in e-commerce

- Enjoys optimizing workflows and systems

- Balances customer experience with operational efficiency



What We Offer



- Competitive salary plus performance-based bonuses

- A senior role with a fast-growing DTC apparel brand

- The opportunity to lead and develop a high-performing team

- Long-term room to grow with the company



How to Apply

We review detailed applications only. Please include:



- Your CV

- The DTC brands you've worked with

- The size of the support team you've managed

- The support systems you've used (Zendesk, Freshdesk, etc.)

- Your strengths as a Customer Service Manager

- How you've worked to reduce refunds and exchanges

- How you track and manage team KPIs

- How you measure and improve support team performance



To confirm you've read the full posting, include the word "DTC" at the end of your application. Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Product Design Artist (Illustrator) — Full-Time — PilatesGoods
description:
Pay: $4–5/hour (based on experience) Hours: Full-time, 40 hrs/week Type: Long-term, home-based



About Us



PilatesGoods is a B2B brand supplying custom branded grip socks and studio essentials to pilates, yoga, and barre studios across Europe, the UK, the US, and Australia/New Zealand. Our look is feminine, clean, and sport-luxe, and every design we ship carries a studio's own branding.



The Role



We're looking for one or two Graphic Designers who are fast and precise in Adobe Illustrator to join our production design team. You'll be creating custom designs across our full product range (grip socks and other studio essentials) for studio clients, using our existing template library. This is a high-volume role: think fast, repeatable, on-brand output, not one-off concept art.



Target pace: roughly one finished design every 7 minutes once you're ramped up. We'll get you there with clear templates and a structured workflow, not by throwing you in cold.



What You'll Do

- Build custom designs across our product range (grip socks and other pilates studio essentials) in Illustrator, using our existing templates and brand assets of our clients.

- Adapt each design to match a specific studio's logo, colors, and branding

- Keep a consistent, feminine, sportswear-appropriate aesthetic across all product categories

- Work through a high volume of design requests daily, hitting quality and speed targets

- Save and organize every finished file in the correct folder structure so the team can find it instantly

- Flag templates or assets that need updating or improving



What We're Looking For

- Strong, demonstrable skills in Adobe Illustrator (please include a portfolio or work samples)

- Fast and accurate, you can work from a template without losing quality

- Good eye for feminine, sporty, aesthetic design (activewear, athleisure, lifestyle brands)

- Comfortable with a structured, repeatable workflow and clear file-naming/folder conventions

- Able to take instructions and brand guidelines and apply them consistently

- Reliable full-time availability, good communication in English

- Experience with apparel, activewear, or merchandise design is a strong plus



How to Apply



Please send:



Your portfolio or a link to relevant Illustrator work (activewear/sportswear/apparel design preferred)

A short note on your typical turnaround time for a single design once you have a template



Your available start date (we prefer ASAP)



We review applications on a rolling basis and will reach out directly to shortlisted candidates.

title: Experienced LinkedIn Appointment Setter | Replies & Booking Only | 4h/day | up to $760/mo
description:
We are looking for a rockstar LinkedIn appointment setter to join one of the most exciting companies in the AI video production industry. If you are experienced, sharp, and you love turning conversations into booked calls, keep reading, this could be the role you have been waiting for.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $550 USD per month, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Realistic total at full speed: $625 to $850 per month. For a 4-hour role, that is top-of-market pay in the Philippines, and it is deliberate. We want to be the job you prioritize.



Hours: around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday. Monday to Friday is your main setting time, and Saturday is a shorter one focused on reactivation messages. Your daily hours sit in a fixed window, morning or afternoon Philippine time, agreed at interview based on the team's coverage needs and your availability, and they stay fixed once agreed.



>> HOW TO APPLY



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video. 

Both are required for the application to be complete.



PART ONE, IN WRITING



1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
. 

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years of appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- How many conversations you were handling at the same time at your busiest

- Your internet setup and your power backup plan, in one or two lines

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone



PART TWO, THE VIDEO



Record a video of yourself, 1 to 2 minutes, face on camera. Keep it simple and natural:



- Introduce yourself: who you are, your hobbies, what you enjoy doing

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience in your own words



You can record it with a free tool like Loom (
): it records you from your browser and gives you a link to paste into your application. Any similar tool works, as long as we can see and hear you clearly.



We use this video for two things: your spoken English and your personality. We are looking for someone engaging, with energy. No script needed, just talk to us.



>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.



>> AUTOMATIC REJECTION



X No presentation video

X No photo of the workstation

X No Speedtest screenshot

X The application does not start with MANGO

X Less than 2 years appointment setting experience

X Applications pitching lead generation, scraping or research services

X Generic, copy-pasted or AI-written text with nothing personal in it

X An unclear situation regarding other jobs and clients



>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai

title: Appointment Setting / SDR: $900AUD + bonuses
description:
About ReskillAI



ReskillAI builds automation systems that replace 50-70% of admin work for Australian businesses. We work with healthcare, finance, property, and professional services companies.



We're growing quickly and looking for the best appointment setters in the game. If you're someone who takes pride in your craft, reads the room, and books meetings that actually convert - keep reading.



The Role



You book qualified Google Meet appointments with Australian business owners. Our senior consultants handle the rest.



This is consultative outreach, not hard selling. You're starting conversations, identifying fit, and scheduling meetings.



But let's be clear: we don't measure success by how many appointments you book. We measure it by how many show up and are genuinely qualified. Anyone can fill a calendar. We want someone who fills it with the right people.



Day-to-day:



Outbound calls, LinkedIn, and
 to business owners in Australia

Qualify prospects using our proven framework (full training provided)

Book and confirm Google Meet appointments that actually show up

Log everything in the CRM



The Pay (This Is Why You Apply)



The initial 3 months will be part-time, 20 hours for $450/mth. Once we see commitment and performance, full-time will be available.



Base: A$900/month - paid regardless. Full-time, 40 hours a week, invoiced fortnightly.



On top of that, you earn commission on the revenue from clients you booked. Uncapped:



Once revenue from your bookings passes A$900 in a month, you earn 20% of everything above that

Once it passes A$1,800, you earn 40% of everything above that



There is no ceiling. Commission is invoiced separately each month and paid within 7 business days.



Notice this pays on revenue, not bookings. You don't get paid for appointments that ghost, and you don't get paid for prospects who were never a real fit. You get paid when the people you found become customers. That's the standard.



The Bar



2 booked appointments per day (must be a show, no fluffy appointments), or 10 per week

Minimum 50% show rate. Booking meetings nobody attends is not the job. Getting them to turn up is the job



You're a Fit If You:



Speak clear, neutral, professional English that an Australian business owner will find easy to follow on a phone call

Have B2B appointment setting or outbound calling experience

Can hold a real conversation, not read a script like a robot

Take ownership of your pipeline - you follow up, you confirm, you make sure they show

Have reliable internet and a quiet workspace

Show up consistently - no gaps, no excuses



You're NOT a Fit If You:



You need micromanaging

You book junk appointments just to hit numbers - we only want qualified appointments that show up!

You treat this like a side gig you'll quit in 2 weeks

You can't handle rejection on calls



What We Provide



Proven call scripts and qualification framework

CRM with warm lead lists (36,000+ leads loaded)

Growth opportunities as we scale (team lead roles opening soon)

Your WhatsApp number and

title: VIP Client Support Associate
description:
We're building a remote VIP Support team for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for people we can grow from the ground up — not just workers, but the kind of people who take genuine pride in doing things right. This role blends support with relationship-building: you won't just resolve client concerns, you'll also learn to spot the right moments to introduce clients to more of what we offer.



This is not a call center role. You'll be managing real relationships with high-value clients — providing support, but also recognizing opportunities to grow those relationships — and holding yourself to a high standard on every single interaction. Our clients are VIPs — quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and work out the correct response on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for judgment. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the processes, tools, and structure you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want people who take initiative to help shape them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Handle inbound client inquiries via messaging platforms with care and thoroughness

• Recognize natural opportunities within conversations to introduce clients to relevant features, promotions, or products that genuinely add value to them

• Use our drafting tool to sharpen your own well-considered responses for supervisor review — the tool supports your judgment; it doesn't replace it

• Keep thorough, accurate track of each client's concerns and history — nothing gets forgotten, nothing falls through the cracks

• Escalate immediately to your Lead when handling an irate or escalating client — do not attempt to resolve it alone

• Maintain detailed and accurate client interaction logs

• Follow team rules, protocols, and procedures diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every client interaction is a once-in-a-lifetime encounter that deserves your full presence and care.



What We're Looking For:



• Early career — fresh graduates welcome, but you need real client-facing experience (internship, part-time work, thesis project, VA work, or similar counts)

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you speak up, express yourself clearly, and don't go quiet when things get uncomfortable

• Understands hierarchy — you know when to handle something yourself and when to bring it to your Lead, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — you track every detail, follow through, and take full ownership of every client you handle

• Relationship-minded — you can naturally spot opportunities to add value for a client, not just resolve their immediate issue

• Follows rules diligently — protocols aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a client's situation yourself, not just reword what a tool gives you

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll be handling sensitive VIP information

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• Holds a TESDA BPO NC II certification

• HubSpot or Zendesk Customer Service certification

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level fluency — especially valuable if you can review Japanese-language drafts for tone and accuracy

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products

• Experience in sales, account management, upselling, or client retention

• Has handled foreign or executive-level clients before



Reporting to: VIP Support Lead and Growth Operations Lead



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• 8 AM–4 PM Philippine Time (JST business hours) to start, 5 days/week — this window may extend depending on client traffic and business needs, so come in with realistic expectations around hours

• No time tracker

• Overtime available as needed and subject to supervisor approval

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — stable fiber internet required

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you handle any client information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status, working full 8-hour days, running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your performance is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[VIP Support] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then answer all three questions below. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. You're handling five VIP clients at the same time. One sends you a voice note. One sends a meme with no context. One hasn't replied in 3 days and suddenly needs urgent help. One says "???" and one says "never mind." Walk us through your exact next 10 minutes.

2. If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

3. Think of a time you were part of a startup or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?

title: Interior Designer
description:
About Us

We are a high-end, rapidly scaling U.S.-based interior design firm that works with luxury real estate developers, builders, agents, and discerning homebuyers. Our approach blends luxury design with practical, turnkey solutions, leveraging curated vendor partnerships and photo-realistic 3D visualization. We operate at the intersection of high-end design, technology and data-driven operations to maximize our reach and impact.



Role Overview

We're looking for a talented interior designer who takes real pride in their work and thrives in a fast-moving environment. This is a creative role, but speed and efficiency matter as much as the quality of the output. You'll take design direction and run with it, translating concepts into polished, client-ready presentations while keeping multiple projects moving at once.



We're also building a design team that stays ahead of the curve, using AI and emerging tools to work smarter, produce faster, and push the quality of our output higher.

title: Signage graphic designer
description:
Fraser Signs Ltd is looking for an experienced freelance graphic designer to provide ad hoc remote design and artwork support when our in-house team requires additional capacity.



We manufacture and install a wide range of signage, vehicle graphics and large-format printed graphics. We are looking for someone who can take a customer brief, existing artwork, photographs, dimensions or sketches and turn these into professional customer visuals and accurate production-ready artwork.



This is not a full-time position. Work will be provided as required, making it suitable for an established freelancer or remote designer looking for additional regular work.



Typical Work



Projects may include:



Shopfront and fascia signage

Vehicle graphics and livery layouts

Window graphics and manifestations

Internal signage

Directional and wayfinding signage

Safety signage

Large-format printed graphics

ACM and panel signage

Hoarding and construction signage

Banners and promotional graphics

Customer presentation visuals

Recreating or cleaning up customer-supplied artwork

Preparing files for print, cutting or manufacture

Responsibilities



The designer will typically be provided with a brief including dimensions, photographs, customer artwork and other relevant information.



You will be expected to:



Produce clear and professional customer visuals/mock-ups

Create designs accurately to supplied dimensions

Follow existing customer branding and brand guidelines

Prepare artwork suitable for large-format printing and vinyl cutting

Set up cut paths, bleed and other production requirements where required

Check artwork resolution and suitability for production

Recreate logos or artwork where suitable vector files are unavailable

Make customer-requested amendments efficiently

Return organised, editable artwork files to Fraser Signs

Highlight any missing information or potential production issues before artwork is approved

Software & Skills



Applicants should have strong experience with:



Adobe Illustrator

Adobe Photoshop

PDF and vector artwork preparation

Working accurately to scale and dimensions

Preparing print-ready artwork



Experience with signage, vehicle graphics, large-format printing or print production is strongly preferred.



Knowledge of RIP software, CNC/router artwork preparation or other signage production processes would also be advantageous.



What We're Looking For



We are particularly interested in someone who:



Works quickly and accurately

Understands that signage design must be practical to manufacture and install

Can interpret relatively simple briefs without excessive supervision

Has excellent attention to detail

Communicates clearly

Can normally provide a quick turnaround during UK working hours

Is comfortable handling revisions

Can maintain consistent standards across different projects

Working Arrangement



This is intended to be a flexible, ad hoc relationship rather than a fixed-hours employment position.



Some weeks may involve little or no work, while busier periods may require several hours or days of support.



We would initially like to work on an hourly basis with no guaranteed minimum number of hours, allowing both parties to assess how well the arrangement works.



If successful, there is potential for the volume of work to increase and for the designer to become a regular external resource for Fraser Signs.



Applying



Please provide:



A brief introduction

Your location/time zone

Your hourly rate

Typical availability and turnaround time

Details of the software you use

Examples of relevant work

Any previous experience in signage, vehicle graphics or large-format print



Please include examples of actual production/signage artwork where possible, rather than solely branding or social-media design.

title: FRACTIONAL E-COMMERCE GROWTH & PROJECT LEAD
description:
Fur Theory is an Australian premium dog care and modern dog living brand created for people who believe their dogs are part of the home, not separate from it.



We are preparing to launch our first two products:

No. 01 — The Barrier Wash

No. 02 — The Restore Mist



The brand has a refined, editorial positioning rather than a traditional pet-store aesthetic. We are currently in the pre-launch/launch stage. The Shopify website is substantially underway, Klaviyo, GA4 and tracking have already been started, and we have a VA supporting execution. We are now looking for someone experienced to lead the commercial growth project from this point forward.



THE ROLE

:: I am looking for an experienced e-commerce growth operator/project lead who can look at the entire customer journey, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the right specialists and make commercially sound decisions about where time and money should go.



You will work with specialist resources across:

:: Shopify/web development

:: Klaviyo/email automation

:: Meta advertising

:: Creative strategy and production

:: SEO

:: Social/content

:: VA/execution support



You do not need to personally execute every one of these disciplines. Your job is to lead the system and make sure the pieces work together.



You will own:

:: The 90-day growth plan

:: Weekly priorities and execution

:: Coordination of specialist contractors

:: Launch readiness

:: Customer acquisition strategy

:: Funnel performance

:: Lead-generation testing

:: Meta advertising strategy and specialist oversight

:: Creative testing roadmap

:: Klaviyo/customer journey strategy

:: Website conversion priorities

:: KPI tracking and weekly reporting

:: Budget allocation and spending decisions

:: Identifying bottlenecks in the customer journey

:: D
 what should be fixed, tested, paused or scaled



The ultimate objective is to build a repeatable customer acquisition and retention system and work toward significant revenue growth, with $100K+ revenue as the initial commercial milestone — not a guaranteed outcome.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR

:: You should have real hands-on e-commerce/DTC growth experience, not simply knowledge of marketing platforms.

:: You need to understand how these pieces connect:

Ad ? landing/product page ? add to cart ? checkout ? purchase ? post-purchase ? repeat purchase

:: You should understand the relationship between:

Traffic

CTR

CPC

Landing-page conversion

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

CPA

ROAS

AOV

Customer acquisition cost

Repeat purchase

 revenue

And, importantly, know what to do when one of those numbers isn't working.



YOU MUST HAVE PROVEN EXPERIENCE

Please don't apply with generic statements such as: "I can manage Meta, Shopify, Klaviyo, SEO and social media."

I want evidence. Please provide at least 2 relevant e-commerce/DTC examples and for each one tell me:

What was the business/product?

What was the approximate monthly ad spend?

What was the starting point?

What result was achieved?

Over what timeframe?

What did you personally do?

What changed because of your work?

Were you working independently or as part of a larger team?

Recent examples are strongly preferred.

Team/agency results that you cannot personally substantiate will not be considered your individual results.



THE FIRST TASK — IMPORTANT

Before I interview you, I want to see how you actually think. Please provide a practical 30-day plan for Fur Theory based on the information above.



Your plan should cover:

Week 1

What would you review first and why?

Week 2

What would you prioritise and what specialists would you need?

Week 3

What would you test?

Week 4

What would you measure and how would you d
 what happens next?



Also include:

Your proposed initial marketing budget

What you would not spend money on yet

The first KPIs you would monitor

What you believe should be completed before launching paid traffic

What you would test before the website is fully live, if anything

How you would coordinate the specialists

What you would report to me each week

I am much more interested in the quality of your thinking than a long application.



WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

You are:

Commercially minded

Analytical

Proactive

Highly organised

Comfortable making decisions

Comfortable managing specialists

Comfortable challenging poor work

Focused on outcomes rather than activity

Experienced with Shopify/DTC

Strong in Meta/customer acquisition strategy

Comfortable understanding Klaviyo and lifecycle marketing

Able to distinguish a traffic problem from a conversion problem

Able to work from data rather than assumptions

You should be comfortable telling me:

"Don't spend money on that yet."

if the numbers or the stage of the business don't justify it.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not:

? A social media posting role

? A VA role

? A generic digital marketing role

? A pure Meta Ads role

? A Shopify developer role

? A content creator role

? A person who simply coordinates meetings and tasks

? A "jack of all trades" position



INITIAL HOURS & RATE

Approximately 10 hours per week initially.



Please provide:

Your hourly rate OR your proposed monthly retainer for approximately 10 hours/week, Your availability. This will initially be a working engagement based on delivery and results, with the potential to increase hours and responsibility as the brand grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your relevant e-commerce/DTC experience

2. Two recent case studies with actual numbers

3. Your 30-day Fur Theory plan

4. Your hourly rate or monthly retainer

5. Your availability

6. A short explanation of why you believe you are suited to LEADING an e-commerce growth project rather than simply executing one marketing channel.



Applications that only say "I can do everything" without evidence will not be considered.



Please put "FUR THEORY GROWTH LEAD" in the subject line of your application.

 sequences

Outbound
 Marketing

 campaigns

 sequences

s

s, conversations, and outcomes

title: Motion Designer to Bring Static Card Art to Life (After Effects)
description:
ABOUT US



HeartStamp is a US greeting card and gifting brand for Millennials and Gen Z

who think traditional cards are generic and emotionally hollow. We make

printed cards and interactive Digital 3D cards. We are small, fast, and

fully remote.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



We already make the art. We need someone to make it move.



Our designers create the illustrations, card designs, and art direction.

Your job is to take those finished static assets and turn them into polished

animated pieces for social, website hero panels, and potentially the Digital

3D cards themselves.



You are not expected to concept visuals from scratch. Creative direction and

source assets come to you. You own the motion, and we want you to push the

work further than we asked for.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Animate still images and illustrations: create depth and movement from

  flat 2D artwork using parallax, layer separation, camera moves, and 2.5D

- Build seamless loops that never show a jump or a boomerang

- Bring card artwork to life: envelopes opening, confetti, foil shimmer,

  paper texture, subtle type animation

- Size and format for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts (9:16),

  in-feed (1:1 and 4:5), and website hero banners (16:9 and wide)

- Web-optimized exports that stay lightweight without losing quality

  (MP4, WebM, GIF, and Lottie where it fits)

- Fast variations of pieces that perform, plus seasonal and campaign versions



THE SKILL WE CARE ABOUT MOST



Knowing what should move, and how much.



The best work here is restrained. A card should feel alive, not busy. If you

can look at a still and instantly know which three elements should move and

which twenty should stay perfectly still, you are the person we want. Fun and

current, never overcomplicated.



MUST HAVE



- A reel that shows motion applied to existing static artwork, illustration

  or photo based. Kinetic type and template work alone will not get you

  shortlisted.

- Strong Adobe After Effects skills: layer separation, parallax rigs,

  camera, puppet and mesh warp, masking, clean loop construction

- Photoshop skills to cut a still into layers and rebuild clean backgrounds

  behind subjects

- Real sense of timing, pacing, and rhythm for short-form social

- Works independently, communicates clearly in written English, hits

  deadlines without chasing

- Reliable internet and power backup, and a machine that handles After

  Effects comfortably



NICE TO HAVE



- Lottie, Rive, or other lightweight web-exportable animation

- Adobe Premiere Pro for edits and UGC-style cuts

- Canva for fast resizes and handoff templates

- AI image and video tools in your workflow, and you can explain

  specifically how you use them

- Experience with consumer, gifting, beauty, or DTC social brands



HOW WE HIRE



We review applications daily on a rolling basis, so apply early. Finalists

are shortlisted and invited to a paid test assignment covering one website

hero panel and one social media asset. We provide all source art and

direction, and we pay for your time on it whether or not we move forward.



Applications close August 28, 2026.



ENGAGEMENT



- Fully remote, Philippines based

- Part-time contract to start, 20 to 30 hours per week, room to grow

- Mostly async. A few hours of overlap with US Pacific time for handoffs.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word PARALLAX so we know you read this.



Then send:



1. Your reel or portfolio link, and point us to the exact timestamp where

   you animated a static image

2. One short paragraph: pick any single shot in your reel and tell us what

   moved, what stayed still, and why you made that call

3. The tools you work in, including any AI tools and how you use them

4. Your hourly rate and how many hours per week you are available



We move fast when we find the right person.

title: Canadian Tax Accountant / Canadian BK (Full-time)
description:
Senior Accountant / Tax Accountant / Bookkeeper



Remote | Canadian Accounting Experience | Full-time



tech-forward cloud accounting firm based in Toronto, Canada. Our fully remote team works across multiple countries and time zones, combining cloud accounting, automation, and tax expertise to help clients manage their finances better and keep more of their hard-earned money.



Role Overview



We’re looking for a motivated accounting professional with Canadian accounting experience who wants to grow with the firm.



This role may be a fit if you come from one of these backgrounds:



1. Canadian Bookkeeper / Senior Bookkeeper

You have strong full-cycle bookkeeping, month-end close, QBO/Xero, and client accounting experience, and you’re willing to learn Canadian tax.



2. Canadian Tax Accountant / Tax Preparer

You already have Canadian tax exposure, such as personal tax, corporate tax, GST/HST, or year-end filings, and want to deepen your tax skills further.



4. Big 4 / Audit / Public Accounting Background

You may not have deep bookkeeping or tax experience yet, but you have strong accounting fundamentals, review discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to learn both bookkeeping and tax workflows quickly.



The ideal person is accurate, detail-oriented, coachable, and comfortable working in a remote accounting firm environment.



Key Responsibilities

You may be involved in some or all of the following, depending on your background and training path:

Perform accurate and timely bookkeeping, including A/P, A/R, GL, bank feeds, credit card feeds, and reconciliations

Handle full-cycle bookkeeping and month-end close using QuickBooks Online or Xero

Assist in preparing year-end financial statements and working papers

Support the preparation of Canadian personal tax returns, corporate tax returns, and GST/HST filings

Review client files for errors, discrepancies, missing information, or unusual transactions

Communicate with clients to gather documents, clarify transactions, explain variances, and provide basic accounting/tax planning support

Help maintain clean, organized, and well-documented client files

Support automation, cloud accounting tools, and process improvements

Coach junior tea
mbers and participate in weekly team calls

Communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous work environment



Qualifications

Must Have

Experience in Canadian accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or public accounting

At least 3 years of accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or finance-related experience

Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors, discrepancies, and missing information

Comfortable working with numbers, reconciliations, reports, and client financial data

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to explain financial information in simple, plain English

Good time management skills and ability to handle multiple client files or deadlines

High ethical standards and commitment to client confidentiality

Willingness to learn and grow further in Canadian tax and cloud accounting

Strongly Preferred

3 to 5+ years of hands-on full-cycle bookkeeping and month-end close experience

Experience using QuickBooks Online or Xero

Experience preparing or supporting Canadian tax filings, including T1, T2, GST/HST, or year-end working papers

Prior experience in a Canadian accounting firm, bookkeeping firm, tax firm, or public accounting environment

CPA completed or in progress







You may be a strong fit if you are:

A Canadian bookkeeper who wants to grow into tax

A Canadian tax accountant who wants to strengthen tax depth and advisory skills

A Big 4, audit, or public accounting candidate who can learn bookkeeping and tax processes quickly

A detail-oriented accountant who can handle client work accurately without needing constant follow-up

Someone who is comfortable with cloud tools, remote work, and continuous learning



Why Join Us

Work with a modern, tech-forward Canadian accounting firm

100% remote setup across multiple time zones

Opportunity to grow your Canadian tax and accounting expertise

Exposure to a diverse client base, from startups to professional corporations

Competitive salary plus performance pay

Ongoing training and learning opportunities

Chance to help shape the firm’s systems, tools, and workflows as we grow



To APPLY: answer the following screening questions along with your cv/resume link



### Screening Questions



1. Can you walk me through your accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or public accounting experience?

 Please include the type of company or firm you worked with, your role, the clients or industries you supported, and the main accounting or tax tasks you personally handled.



2. Which profile best matches your background? Please choose one and explain your fit.

   A) Canadian bookkeeping experience and willing to learn Canadian tax

   B) Canadian tax experience and willing to grow further in tax

   C) No Canadian bookkeeping/tax experience, but with Big 4 audit, public accounting, or strong accounting experience and willing to learn Canadian bookkeeping and tax



3. If you selected Profile A or B, please describe your Canadian accounting or tax experience.

 What Canadian clients, filings, bookkeeping tasks, tax returns, GST/HST work, year-end work, or accounting firm tasks have you handled?



4. If you selected Profile C, please describe your Big 4, audit, public accounting, or strong accounting background.

What types of clients did you handle, what accounting areas did you review or prepare, and why do you think your background can transfer well into Canadian bookkeeping and tax work?



5. Can you describe your hands-on experience with full-cycle bookkeeping, month-end close, reconciliations, year-end work, or tax filings?**Please mention the tools you used, such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, Dext, Hubdoc, Excel, Power BI, or other accounting/tax software.



6. Tell us about a time you found an error, discrepancy, missing document, or unusual transaction in a client’s books, audit file, or tax file. **What did you notice, how did you investigate it, and how did you resolve or escalate it?



7. This is a remote role that may require working Canadian business hours, which can mean night shift. Have you worked night shift, Canadian hours, or US hours before? If yes, can you commit to EST hours?

title: HubSpot Website & Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
The role in one line



You will own our HubSpot website — keeping it accurate, fast to update, and properly connected to the CRM behind it.



________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



About us



We are an Australian events and professional development company running 10–15 live conferences and summits at any one time, across leadership, public sector, HR, diversity and innovation. Our brands include The Leadership Institute and Konnect Learning.



Our entire web presence runs on HubSpot CMS Hub, and our speaker and delegate data lives in HubSpot CRM. The two are deeply linked, and that link is the heart of this job.



You will work alongside our graphic designer as a two-person team: they create the visuals, you get them live and make sure the data behind them is right.



____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Why this role exists

We add at least 15 new speakers a week across our events. Every one needs a bio, headshot, job title and session detail published to the correct event page. Speakers then send revisions constantly — new headshots, updated titles, changed session times.



There is not a two-day stretch where our website does not need a change.



Right now this work gets bottlenecked. We need someone who owns it, moves fast, and does not need chasing.



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What you will do

Website (the core of the job)



Build new pages in HubSpot CMS from scratch — event pages, speaker pages, landing pages — choosing and arranging modules to suit the content, not just cloning an old page

Publish and update event pages, speaker profiles and agendas

Create and maintain forms, and check they are capturing correctly

Upload graphics supplied by our designer, at the right size and format

Check every page renders properly on desktop and mobile before calling it done

Keep pages consistent — correct job titles, correct session times, no stale content



CRM and the interplay



Understand how website forms, pages and CTAs feed contact records in HubSpot CRM

Keep contact and speaker data clean, correctly associated and properly segmented

Make sure a change on the website is reflected in the CRM, and the reverse



Marketing operations — as you grow into the role



Build marketing
s in HubSpot using existing templates

Set up and maintain workflows for registration confirmations and nurture sequences

Pull basic reporting on page performance, form conversion and
 engagement



Working with the team



Take work from a shared task queue rather than scattered chat messages

Flag blockers early instead of going quiet

Confirm clearly when something is live



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Essential requirements

You must have hands-on HubSpot experience. This is not a role where you can learn HubSpot as you go. Specifically:



HubSpot CMS Hub, at a build level. You can create a genuinely new page — choosing and arranging modules, working with drag-and-drop areas and theme settings — not only clone and edit an existing one. This is the single most important requirement in this ad.

Some HTML and CSS. Enough to adjust a module, fix spacing, or make something behave properly on mobile when the editor alone will not do it.

HubSpot CRM — contacts, properties, associations, lists and segmentation

A real understanding of how the website and the CRM connect — forms, CTAs, tracking and lifecycle stages. We want someone who sees the website and the database as one system, not two.

Strong general website experience beyond HubSpot — you have built or maintained real sites and understand layout, image optimisation and mobile behaviour

Accuracy under volume. This job involves a lot of small changes where details matter.

Speed. We need same-day turnaround on most requests.

Clear written English and reliable, consistent communication

Availability overlapping Australian Eastern Standard Time business hours (roughly 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM PHT). This is non-negotiable — we need to resolve things with you in real time.

Welcome, and where this role grows

We would rather hire someone excellent at the website work who can grow into operations than someone who talks a good game on automation but cannot build a page.



So the following are genuinely optional, and we will support you in developing them:



HubSpot marketing
 builds

HubSpot workflows and automation

Reporting and dashboards

HubSpot custom objects

HubL templating



If you already have some of this, say so — it will count in your favour and shape how quickly the role expands. If you do not, apply anyway provided your CMS and CRM skills are solid.

Also nice to have

HubSpot certifications (CMS Hub, Marketing Hub, Marketing Software)

Basic image editing — cropping and resizing headshots to spec

Experience in events, education or conferences

Familiarity with ClickUp



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Who this suits

You are meticulous, you like a clear queue of work and clearing it, and you take quiet pride in a site that is always correct. You would rather ask a question than guess. You do not need reminding.



If you enjoy owning a system and keeping it in good order, you will like this role.



____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



The details



Hours: 2–4 hours per day, Monday to Friday, with overlap into Australian business hours

Rate: AUD $8–10 per hour depending on demonstrated HubSpot experience

Type: Ongoing, long-term. We are looking for someone to stay with us.

Growth: This role is designed to grow. Get the website side right and there is scope to take on our wider HubSpot marketing operations, with more hours and a higher rate to match.



________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

How to apply

Please answer all of the following. Applications that do not address the HubSpot questions specifically will not be considered — we need to see real experience, not a general VA application.



How long have you worked in HubSpot, and in what capacity? Name the hubs and tools you have used.

Have you built a brand new page in HubSpot CMS Hub from scratch? Walk us through how you did it — how you chose and arranged the modules, and anything you had to do in HTML or CSS. Include links to live pages if you can. This is the question we care most about.

Explain in your own words how a HubSpot website connects to the HubSpot CRM. We want to understand how you think about it, not a textbook answer.

What other website experience do you have outside HubSpot? Platforms, and examples we can look at.

Give an example of high-volume, detail-heavy work you have handled and how you kept it accurate.

Optional: describe any HubSpot
, workflow or reporting work you have done. If you have none, say so honestly — it will not rule you out.

Your available hours in Philippine time.

Your hourly rate in AUD.

Any HubSpot certifications you hold.



We read every application properly and reply to shortlisted candidates.

title: ClickUp + ServiceM8 + n8n Automation Build — Job Management System for Trades Business
description:
**ClickUp + ServiceM8 + n8n Automation Build — Job Management System for Trades Business**



We're a tiling contracting company in New Zealand looking for an experienced n8n automation specialist to build an integration between ServiceM8 (job management) and ClickUp (VA task/workflow system).



**The architecture:**

- ServiceM8 = source of truth for all customer/job data (quotes, invoices, scheduling, client comms)

- ClickUp = internal workflow/task system for our virtual assistant — no customer data duplication

- n8n = automation layer connecting the two



Full spec (statuses, fields, templates, workflow logic, dedup rules) is written and ready to hand over — this is implementation, not design work.



**Scope:**

1. Build ClickUp workspace: 8-stage job lifecycle, ~20 custom fields, task templates (core job checklist, closeout checklist, optional add-ons for UFH/council/PS3), views, and native ClickUp automations

2. Build 9 n8n workflows connecting ServiceM8 ? ClickUp:

   - Create/update ClickUp job when ServiceM8 job becomes a Work Order (with strict duplicate prevention keyed on ServiceM8 Job UUID)

   - Sync core job fields (status, address, start date, etc.)

   - Move job to "In Progress" on first site visit

   - Auto-generate daily task checklist while job is in progress (deduped by date)

   - Move job to "Closeout" when marked Completed in ServiceM8

   - Mirror invoice-sent and payment-received status

   - Create 6-month follow-up reminder on completion

   - Visible error handling (no silent failures, no leaked credentials/data)

3. Test and validate — replay/duplicate-safety testing is mandatory, not optional



**Requirements:**

- Proven experience with n8n (show us workflows you've built)

- Experience with ServiceM8 API/webhooks specifically, or strong general REST API/webhook integration experience

- Experience with ClickUp API, custom fields, and automations

- Comfortable working from a detailed written spec and flagging issues rather than guessing

- Strong on idempotency/duplicate-prevention — this is critical, not a nice-to-have



**What we'll provide:**

- Full written specification (architecture, field lists, workflow logic, status definitions, test cases)

- ServiceM8 and ClickUp account access

- Direct point of contact for questions during the build



**Structure:** We'd like to start with a fixed-price milestone covering the ClickUp build + the first (and most critical) n8n workflow, tested and proven, before committing to the full build.



**Timeline:** Estimated 35–55 hours total. Please quote your rate and estimated timeline for the first milestone.



To apply, please include:

- 1–2 examples of similar integration work (ServiceM8, ClickUp, or comparable job-management/CRM systems)

- Your hourly rate or fixed-price approach

- Any questions about the spec before we share full details

title: Senior Commercial Real Estate Financial Analyst (U.S. CRE)
description:
Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Semi-flexible, typically 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM Manila Time





About Us



We are a well-funded and fast-growing FinTech company founded by industry leaders from Wall Street and Silicon Valley. Our mission is to transform how commercial real estate financial data is processed through advanced technology, automation, and artificial intelligence.



As part of our continued growth, we’re building a team of experienced Commercial Real Estate professionals who can accurately interpret complex U.S. CRE financial documents and transform them into high-quality structured datasets that power next-generation AI models.







About the Role



We are seeking a Senior Commercial Real Estate Financial Analyst with a strong background in U.S. Commercial Real Estate accounting, underwriting, and financial analysis.



This role goes beyond document review. You will analyze and validate financial information from commercial real estate documents, ensuring accuracy and consistency while applying your accounting and financial expertise to interpret complex transactions.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with T12 operating statements, rent rolls, loan agreements, property financial statements, and underwriting packages for U.S. commercial real estate assets.







Key Responsibilities



* Review and analyze U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial documents, including:

* Trailing Twelve Month (T12) Operating Statements

* Property Profit & Loss Statements

* Balance Sheets

* Rent Rolls

* Loan Agreements

* Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae loan documents

* Offering Memorandums (OMs)

* Purchase & Sale Agreements

* Appraisal Reports

* Property Financial Statements

* Interpret financial data and ensure information is accurately extracted and validated.

* Analyze financial metrics including:

* Net Operating Income (NOI)

* Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)

* Capitalization Rate (Cap Rate)

* Occupancy

* Operating Expenses

* Effective Gross Income (EGI)

* Debt Service

* Cash Flow

* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across multiple financial documents.

* Validate extracted financial data using accounting principles and CRE best practices.

* Organize and maintain structured datasets used for AI model training.

* Collaborate with internal teams to improve extraction accuracy and document review processes.

* Maintain the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and data integrity.





Required Qualifications



Experience



* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in U.S. Commercial Real Estate.

* Background in Accounting, Finance, Commercial Real Estate, Asset Management, Underwriting, or Commercial Lending.

* Experience analyzing U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial statements.

* Hands-on experience reviewing T12 Operating Statements is required.

* Experience reviewing Rent Rolls is required.

* Experience reviewing Loan Agreements and financing documents.

* Experience supporting underwriting, acquisitions, asset management, lending, or due diligence.

* This role is not suitable for junior analysts.







Technical Skills



Must have strong understanding of:



* U.S. Commercial Real Estate

* Multifamily properties

* Property accounting

* Financial statement analysis

* Commercial lending

* Underwriting

* GAAP accounting fundamentals

* NOI

* DSCR

* Cap Rate

* Debt Service

* Cash Flow Analysis

* Rent Roll Analysis

* T12 Financial Analysis





Excel & Analytical Skills



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required, including:



* Pivot Tables

* XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH

* SUMIFS

* Logical formulas

* Financial calculations

* Data validation

* Large dataset analysis



You should be highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex financial datasets.





Preferred Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:



* Freddie Mac

* Fannie Mae

* CMBS loans

* Yardi

* RealPage

* MRI

* Argus Enterprise

* CoStar

* Commercial loan servicing

* CRE acquisitions

* Multifamily underwriting

* Asset management





Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who can confidently answer YES to most of the following:



* ? I have an accounting or finance background.

* ? I’ve analyzed U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial statements.

* ? I’ve worked with T12 Operating Statements.

* ? I’ve analyzed Rent Rolls.

* ? I’ve reviewed Loan Agreements.

* ? I’m comfortable calculating and interpreting NOI, DSCR, and Cap Rates.

* ? I have advanced Excel skills.

* ? I’ve supported underwriting, acquisitions, lending, or asset management.

* ? I can identify inconsistencies across multiple financial documents.

* ? I’m comfortable working with large volumes of financial data while maintaining exceptional accuracy.





Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.

**Role Overview**

Mountain Research & Image Sourcing

Design & Mock-up Production

Workflow Integration

- Experience with AI image generation tools is a strong plus

$800 to $1,200 per month depending on experience

title: AI Implementation & Client Success Specialist
description:
NxtLayr AI helps businesses turn AI from scattered experiments into practical systems their teams can use every day.



We’re looking for a hands-on AI Implementation & Client Success Specialist who can work directly with clients, understand how their businesses operate, and build useful, reliable AI systems.



This is not a general admin VA position. You’ll work closely with the founder, help deliver client projects, support and train users and client staff, and gradually take ownership of implementation and client success. For the right person, this role can grow into an AI Delivery Lead position as NxtLayr AI grows.



ROLE DETAILS:

• Independent-contractor engagement  

• Approximately 20–25 hours per week for the first 2-3 months.  

• US$9–$12 per hour, depending on experience  

• Ideally available between 8:00 am and 3:00 pm Philippine Time on weekdays  

• Potential to grow toward full-time contractor capacity as client demand increases  



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Meet clients on Google Meet/Zoom to understand their workflows, pain points, constraints and desired outcomes.



• Scope, build, test and implement practical AI systems using Claude Cowork, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Make and other suitable tools.



• Build confidently with Claude Projects, Skills, Scheduled Tasks, connectors, integrations and related functions.



• Translate business problems into clear implementation plans and carry the work through to a reliable outcome.



• Manage approved client delivery work, including progress updates, quality assurance, documentation and handover.



• Respond to client questions through
 and Slack during agreed working hours.



• Run practical AI education and training sessions for business owners and their teams.



• Troubleshoot issues, identify risks early and improve systems based on client feedback and real-world use.



• Document what has been built so clients and the NxtLayr team can understand, use and maintain it.



ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:



• Strong hands-on experience with Claude Cowork and/or Claude Code. You must be able to build and troubleshoot independently, not only use Claude for basic prompting.



• Practical experience with Claude Projects, Skills, Scheduled Tasks, connectors/integrations and other related functions.



• Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to run client meetings and explain technical ideas simply.



• Previous experience working directly with clients, providing support or managing implementation work.



• The ability to understand how a business operates and turn an unclear problem into a sensible, usable solution.



• Proactive, organised and detail-oriented. You can move work forward without needing constant instructions.



• Honest about what you know and don’t know, and willing to ask questions, research and learn quickly.



• Careful when handling client information and willing to follow documented privacy, security and quality processes.



• Reliable internet, a professional camera and microphone setup, and a quiet environment for client meetings.



PREFERRED SKILLS (not essential, but nice-to-have):



• Experience with ONE of: Make, n8n, Zapier.



• API integration, coding or technical troubleshooting experience.



• Experience supporting financial advisers, financial planning firms or other finance and regulated professional-services businesses.



• Experience in customer success, implementation, project coordination or team training.



• Experience documenting systems, writing clear guides or recording Loom walkthroughs.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:



• Client work is delivered reliably and to the agreed scope.



• AI systems work as intended and are genuinely useful to the business.



• Clients receive clear, timely and friendly communication.



• Documentation and handovers are easy for others to understand.



• Risks, blockers and unknowns are raised early rather than hidden.



• You take increasing ownership of delivery and help improve how the team works.



• Training calls, team enablement and other sessions are recorded & made available to the business for re-viewing to form their AI education repository.



ABOUT NXTLAYR AI:



NxtLayr AI is a growing AI consulting business that helps companies build and adopt practical AI systems. We are moving quickly and have a number of clients we are actively servicing. Our service is delivered in a 3 pillar approach:



• Build: We build intelligent AI agents and intuitive systems to help the business work faster and get more done.

• Educate: We teach business owners and staff how to use systems and get better and integrating AI into their everyday work.

• Maintain: We continue team-wide education, system iteration & improvements and keep everything running. 



You’ll report directly to Chris Gulotta, the founder of NxtLayr AI. This is our first dedicated delivery hire, which means you’ll have direct exposure to clients, varied implementation work and the opportunity to help shape how our delivery function develops.



Our values are straightforward:



• Clients come first.



• If you don’t know something, be honest—then put in the work to find the answer.



• Don't be scared to ask questions - it's best to ask than assume.



• Take ownership and keep work moving.



• Be positive, thoughtful and easy to work with.



• Care about doing useful work, not just making something that looks impressive.



APPLICATION PROCESS



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with a short introduction and any relevant examples of AI systems, automations, client projects or Loom walkthroughs you have created.



Our selection process is intentionally simple:



1. Shortlisted applicants will receive an
 with a short form containing questions about their experience and skills.



2. Successful applicants will be invited to one virtual meeting.



3. Finalists will complete a short practical assessment or record a Loom walkthrough so we can understand how they think and work.



We’ll then select the preferred candidate and agree on the engagement details.
