title: Retail Recruiter
description:
Company Overview

We are a Singapore-based retail company with multiple retail locations and a growing team. We are looking for a Retail Recruiter to support our ongoing recruitment needs across our retail operations.

This is a hands-on recruiting role focused on finding, contacting, screening, and coordinating candidates. You will work closely with our management team and play an important role in building our retail workforce.



Role Overview

* Position: Retail Recruiter

* Location: Remote

* Hours: 12–20 hours per week

* Schedule: Approximately 2–4 hours per day, 6 days per week

* Time Zone: Must be available and responsive during Singapore Standard Time (SGT) operational hours

* Employment Type: Part-Time, with the option to move into a full-time position for the right person

* Payment: Paid every 2 weeks

* Career Growth: We offer career advancement opportunities for strong performers. As our recruitment needs grow, there is potential to take on greater responsibility and progress into a senior recruiter, recruitment lead, or full-time recruitment role.



Key Responsibilities

* Review applications from Singapore job portals such as JobStreet, FastJobs, MyCareersFuture and other recruitment platforms.

* Identify candidates who meet the basic requirements for our retail positions.

* Conduct initial screening and assess candidates for suitability, communication skills, availability, experience and overall fit.

* Maintain a consistent flow of suitable candidates for our retail vacancies.

* Conduct short first-stage video interviews using Zoom, Google Meet, WhatsApp Video or another suitable platform.

* Assess communication skills, confidence, presentation, attitude and suitability for customer-facing retail positions.

*  

* Update the candidate tracking system on a daily basis.



What We Are Looking For

* Previous experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, HR, staffing or a similar role.

* Experience recruiting retail, sales, hospitality, beauty or other customer-facing positions is an advantage.

* Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with candidates.

* Comfortable communicating with candidates through video calls.

* Good English communication skills.

* Organized, reliable and able to work independently.

* Able to manage multiple candidates and vacancies simultaneously.

* Proactive approach — you should be comfortable following up with candidates rather than waiting for them to respond.

* Strong attention to detail when recording candidate information and interview results.



Why Join Us?

* Flexible remote working arrangement

* Payment every 2 weeks

* Consistent recruitment work rather than one-off projects

* Opportunity to work directly with a growing Singapore retail company

* Potential to increase hours and transition to full-time employment

* Career advancement opportunities based on performance

* Opportunity to take on greater recruitment responsibility as the company grows



Application Questions

Important: Please type GRAVITY at the very top of your application response. Applications without this word may not be considered.



Please answer the following questions:

1. Schedule?Can you commit to working approximately 12–20 hours per week, generally 2–4 hours per day, 6 days per week, and being accessible during Singapore Standard Time (SGT) operational hours?

2. Recruitment Experience?Describe your recent experience with recruitment or similar projects. Please include the types of positions you have recruited for and approximately how many candidates you typically handle.

3. Hard-to-Fill Position — Video Recording?Please record a short (1-3 min) video introduction and describe a time when you had to recruit for a hard-to-fill position. Explain how you approached the search, how you contacted candidates, and what the outcome was.

You may use any convenient recording platform or app. Please share the recording as a link or file with your application.

4. Video Screening?Have you conducted video or phone interviews with candidates before? If yes, briefly describe your approach to evaluating whether a candidate is suitable.

5. Resume?Please attach a copy of your current resume to your application.

6. Availability & Growth?Are you interested in potentially increasing your hours or moving into a full-time recruitment position in the future if the opportunity becomes available? Please explain briefly.



Application Instruction

At the very top of your response, please write:

GRAVITY

Then answer all of the questions above and attach your resume.

title: AI UGC Creator — Full Production Ownership (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We run a DTC e-commerce brand and we grow it with organic short-form video. Every video is made with AI — AI presenters, AI voices, no filming, no shipping product to influencers.



You own the entire production. Not "assist with." Own. You research what's working, write the script, build the prompt, generate the video, judge whether it's good, re-roll it until it is, edit it, caption it, and post it. We approve the claims you're allowed to make and the product facts. Everything else is yours.



This is a volume game. We're not making one perfect video a week. We're making a lot of videos, killing the ones that don't work fast, and doubling down on the angles that do.



YOUR DAILY LOOP



Research — study what's performing in our niche and adjacent ones on TikTok. Save the hooks and formats that stop the scroll.

Write — script it yourself. Hook in the first two seconds, one clear idea, natural spoken language with filler words left in. 15–30 seconds.

Prompt — build the Seedance 2.5 prompt: presenter, setting, camera behavior, gestures, eyeline, audio, and the script as spoken dialogue. We'll train you on the format.

Generate — run it on kie.ai with our presenter reference images.

Judge it honestly — most first generations are not good enough. Face drifted, voice too announcer-y, dead eyes, mouth out of sync, background melted.

Iterate — change the prompt, not just the seed. Re-roll until it passes. This is the actual skill in this job.

Edit — CapCut. Hard cuts, burned-in captions matching the audio exactly, cutdowns.

Post — upload to TikTok and Instagram with the AI-generated content label toggled ON, every time.

Log — production tracker: script, angle, hook type, generations used, credits spent, post time, 48-hour performance.



WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GOOD AT THIS



The rare skill isn't generating video. It's looking at a clip that's pretty good and knowing it isn't good enough, then knowing which words in the prompt to change. You'll re-roll the same ad six times to fix an eyeline. If that sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this isn't your role.



Second thing: taste. You'll write hundreds of scripts. The ones that work sound like a real person talking, not like an ad.



TOOLS



kie.ai — Seedance 2.5. Form interface: prompt, reference_image_urls, aspect ratio, duration. Any AI video experience transfers (HeyGen, Arcads, Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Veo).

ChatGPT image generation / Nano Banana — presenter and background reference images

CapCut — edit, caption, cutdown

TikTok + Instagram — native posting

Google Sheets / Drive — tracker and asset library

TikTok Creative Center or Kalodata — competitive research



THE CLAIMS RULES — READ THIS TWICE



You write the scripts. You do not invent what the product does. We'll give you an approved claims sheet and a banned-words list. Those are the boundaries, and they're not negotiable:



Only claims on the approved sheet. If a hook needs a claim that isn't on it, ask — don't write it and hope.

No health, medical, cure, treatment, or disease claims. Ever. Not "helps with," not "may support," not implied through before/afters or symptoms.

No income, earnings, or savings claims.

No "clinically proven," "FDA approved," "doctor recommended," "#1," or "guaranteed" unless it's on the sheet with substantiation.

Our presenter is never a customer. She never says she bought it, used it, or got a result. She's a brand presenter talking about the product. This is the single most important rule in the job.

No real people, no celebrities, no competitor brand names, no borrowed footage.

AI label on every upload.



A video that breaks these is worse than no video. One of them can cost us the account.



REQUIREMENTS



Fluent, natural written English — you're writing spoken dialogue for a US audience, and it has to sound American, not translated

You watch a lot of TikTok and can explain why a specific video worked

Extremely process-driven, and comfortable with repetitive iteration

Some overlap with US hours

Internet that can upload video reliably all day

Bonus: you've run a short-form account of your own, in any language

s

We don't expect you to solve every situation independently from day one. You'll learn our policies, suppliers, workflows, and way of working during onboarding.

title: APPOINTMENT SETTER / CREATOR
description:
APPOINTMENT SETTER / CREATOR

UGC • Content Creation • Lead Generation • Social Commerce

30-Day Paid Trial: $900 Guaranteed + Uncapped Commission

Growth Path: Social Commerce Sales Manager



We are building a new social commerce division focused on helping creators, aspiring entrepreneurs and social-media-native people launch their own skincare businesses.

We are looking for our first Appointment Setter / Creator.

This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant position.

It is NOT a cold-calling job.

And it is not a job where you sit around waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

We are looking for someone who can create content, find the right people, start conversations and turn interest into qualified sales appointments.

If you are comfortable in front of a camera, understand social media and enjoy talking to people, this could be a very good opportunity.



WHAT WE DO

We help people launch their own private-label skincare business without having to invest thousands of dollars into inventory, manufacturing or product development.

We build the infrastructure for them.

Depending on the package, we provide:

? A ready-to-sell Shopify store

? 5, 15 or 30 skincare products

? Their own private skincare brand

? Product branding and design

? High-quality European-made skincare products

? Sales strategy

? Personal sales mentoring

? Ongoing support

Our packages are:

$300 — 5 products

$500 — 15 products

$800 — 30 products

And we stand behind the system with a:

90-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE

If a client follows our system and recommendations and does not earn back their investment in our service within 90 days, we refund the service fee.

Our objective is not simply to sell a Shopify store.

We want our clients to build businesses that actually generate sales.



YOUR ROLE

Your job is simple to understand:

Find the right people ? start conversations ? create interest ? qualify them ? book the appointment.

You will be the first human interaction many potential customers have with our company.

You will work primarily through social media.

You will:

? Find potential customers in relevant
 groups and social communities

? Post useful and engaging content

? Create UGC-style videos for TikTok, Instagram,
 and other platforms

? Reply to comments

? Start conversations through DM

? Identify people who are genuinely interested in starting an online business

? Explain the opportunity at a basic level

? Qualify potential customers

? Book Google Meet appointments

? Follow up with interested prospects

? Occasionally present the opportunity yourself on Google Meet

? Pass qualified prospects to the sales process

You will receive complete training on our products, offer, sales process, communication and content strategy.

You don't need to know our system when you start.

You need to be willing to learn it.



YOU ARE ALSO A CREATOR

This is a key part of the role.

We don't want someone simply copying advertisements into
 groups.

We want someone who understands how people actually consume content.

You should be able to create simple, authentic videos that people want to watch.

For example:

“Why UGC creators should consider building their own brand.”

“How I would start a skincare business without buying inventory.”

“Why having an audience is more valuable than having 10,000 followers.”

“How creators can make money without waiting for brands to hire them.”

You don't need expensive equipment.

You don't need a huge following.

You don't need to be a professional influencer.

You need to be comfortable talking to a camera and communicating naturally.

Your personality matters more than perfect production.



OUR TARGET AUDIENCE

Our service is designed for people who want to build a social-commerce-based skincare business with low entry barriers and strong support.

We primarily work with:

? UGC creators and content creators who want to monetize their audience and move beyond brand collaborations

? Aspiring entrepreneurs who want to start an online business without holding inventory or dealing with manufacturing

? Social-media-native individuals who are comfortable on camera and understand how online attention works

? People interested in beauty, skincare and wellness industries

? Young mothers or individuals seeking flexible, location-independent income

? Micro-influencers and emerging creators looking to build their own brand instead of promoting others

? Individuals who want to launch a product-based business with a ready-made system and support structure

In short, we help people who already understand or are actively involved in social media, and who want to turn that into a real business opportunity.



THE COMMISSION

This position has a 30-day paid trial period.

During the first 30 days:

$900 guaranteed compensation

PLUS:

Uncapped commission

$100 for every $300 package sold

$200 for every $500 package sold

$300 for every $800 package sold

There is no commission ceiling.

The more qualified customers you generate, the more you earn.

The $900 is guaranteed during the paid trial period, so you have the opportunity to learn the business, understand the market and prove yourself without taking all the risk.



AFTER THE TRIAL

If we both decide that we're a good fit, you move into the permanent role with an increased performance-based compensation structure.

And there is a clear growth path.

Creator-Salesperson

?

Senior Creator-Salesperson

?

Social Commerce Sales Manager

Our goal is to build a sales team around this model.

As we grow, the person who proves that they can consistently generate leads, create content and convert conversations into appointments will have the opportunity to lead other appointment setters and creators.

We want to build this position into a real management role, not keep you doing the same thing forever.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MORE THAN EXPERIENCE

You don't need a university degree.

You don't need 10 years of sales experience.

You don't even need traditional sales experience if you can demonstrate the right personality and skills.

We care about:

Communication

Can you talk naturally to people?

Confidence

Can you appear on camera without freezing?

Curiosity

Do you actually want to understand people and what makes them buy?

Initiative

Can you find opportunities without being given a checklist every morning?

Consistency

Can you create content and start conversations every day?

Sales instinct

Can you recognize when someone is genuinely interested?

Learning ability

Can you take feedback and improve quickly?



ONE THING WE DON'T WANT

Someone who waits for instructions.

We will give you:

? Training

? Scripts

? Content ideas

? Product information

? Sales materials

? Our proven process

? Support

But we expect you to think.

If you discover a
 group nobody else is using — tell us.

If you find a content format that generates conversations — make more of it.

If you discover a better way to reach UGC creators — test it.

If you think something in our sales process can be improved — speak up.

We are looking for someone who eventually thinks like a Sales Manager, not someone who needs to be managed every minute.



WHY SKINCARE?

Because skincare is one of the strongest categories for social commerce.

People already buy it.

Creators already talk about it.

UGC works naturally with it.

And our products are not random marketplace products.

We work with high-quality European manufacturing and skincare formulas that use a strong percentage of natural ingredients.

This makes the offer much easier to communicate through authentic creator content.



WHY THIS ROLE COULD BE INTERESTING FOR YOU

You won't simply be selling someone else's product.

You will learn:

? Social selling

? Lead generation

? Appointment setting

? Content marketing

? UGC

? Personal branding

? Social commerce

? Sales psychology

? Online business development

These are skills you can use anywhere in the future.

And if you perform well, you can grow into a management position within the company.



HOW TO APPLY

Read this part carefully.

Please do NOT send:

“Hi, I'm interested.”

Generic applications will be ignored.

Start your application with:

CREATOR

Then answer these 4 questions:

1. Have you created content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or
? What type of content?

2. Are you comfortable appearing on camera and speaking naturally to an audience?

3. Have you ever sold something, generated leads or convinced someone to take an action? Tell us briefly about it.

4. Why does social commerce and building an online business interest you?

Please also include:

? Examples of your content, if available

? Your availability for the next 30 days



The first 30 days are a paid trial.

$900 guaranteed + uncapped commission.

If you prove that you can create content, generate conversations and book qualified appointments, there is a real opportunity to grow with us.

We are looking for our first Creator-Salesperson.

And if you are good at this, the goal is not for you to remain an appointment setter.

The goal is for you to eventually become the person leading the sales team.

Start your application with CREATOR.

WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MORE THAN EXPERIENCE

You don't need a university degree.

title: Virtual Assistant — Tender & Project Documentation | simPRO & Construction Industry Experience Preferred | Part-Time
description:

You'll prepare and maintain tender pricing spreadsheets, complete project returnable documents and Record of Works (ROW) documents, compile and send Invitations to Tender (ITTs) to contractors and suppliers, and enter Supplier Invoices against Purchase Orders in simPRO.



This is a documentation- and detail-heavy role rather than a phone-heavy one. You'll need strong written English, confidence building and maintaining more complex Excel spreadsheets, and comfort learning simPRO's invoicing and reporting functions. A formal procedure only exists for the Supplier Invoice task so far, currently being documented by the team's existing VA. The other four task areas will be trained live by the Project Coordinator, and you'll help turn that training into usable SOPs as you go, the same way it's worked for the rest of the team.

title: SaaS Sales Representative
description:
Skytree Scientific® builds lightning risk intelligence software. Our platform, LRAplus®, runs quantitative lightning risk assessment to IEC 62305-2:2024 Edition 3 for engineers and asset owners worldwide. Our customers are engineering consultancies across Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. 



We are hiring a SaaS Sales Representative to convert qualified pipeline into signed deals. 



This is a closing role. You will not be cold sourcing or building lists. Leads arrive qualified. Your job is to run the discovery call, give the demo, work the objections and get the contract signed. 



The motion is high-volume and fast: transactional to mid-size deals, not six-month enterprise pursuits. 



Our team works across multiple time zones, so we need someone who takes ownership of the role and moves the product forward on their own initiative. Beyond the hard skills, we want to work with people who are kind, reliable and trustworthy, and eager to grow in a startup environment. 



Responsibilities: 

Run discovery and demo calls with qualified prospects. 

Handle objections on price, timing and authority, and move deals to close. 

Navigate the buying group: prep your champion, identify the economic buyer, and build consensus across the decision team. 

Keep HubSpot current: log activity, update deal stages, maintain clean pipeline data. 

Coordinate with our account and technical teams so what you commit to on a call is what we can deliver. 

Keep objection-handling notes and feed recurring questions back to the team. 



Requirements:

SaaS or software sales experience. This one is not negotiable. Selling software is a different motion from selling hardware and we need someone who already knows it. 

Demonstrated B2B closing experience against a documented sales process. Be ready to share your quota attainment and win rate, walk us through specific deals, and explain your sales methodology. 

College degree preferred, and/or an equivalent closing track record. 

Based in the Philippines, with a reliable primary internet connection and a working backup. 

Your own work laptop or computer. 

Willingness to work flexible hours against customer time zones in Europe, MENA or Asia-Pacific (APAC). 

Strong spoken and written English for international customer-facing calls. 

CRM fluency, HubSpot preferred, with disciplined pipeline hygiene. 

A warm, credible, coachable presence. Attitude and fit count as much as skill here. 



Preferences:

Enterprise software experience. 

Familiarity with lightning risk or weather risk. 

Ability to hold a credible conversation with a technical buyer without an engineering background. 

Experience selling into a technical space, such as utilities or infrastructure. 

Experience selling software that quantifies or measures risk in another industry. 



Engagement and pay:

Pay is competitive, structured as a base plus commission. Specific figures are discussed at interview. 

This is a full-time contractor role from the start, with a 90-day probationary period. 

On passing the 90-day review, the base steps up and the commission strengthens, with an accelerator above quota. Qualified leads keep arriving from our account team; alongside closing them you take on CRM hygiene and pipeline management. Base and scope are reviewed annually from that point. 

The 90-day review looks at deals closed against target, conversion on qualified opportunities, CRM discipline, product fluency and how well you work with the rest of the team. 



How to apply

Read this part carefully. Applications that skip any step are not reviewed. 

Open your application with the word BOLT on the first line. 

1. Answer these three questions, in order: 

a. What software or SaaS product have you sold, and to what kind of buyer? 

b. Describe one software deal you closed: approximate deal size, and how you handled the main objection. 

c. What is your current close rate on qualified opportunities, and how do you know? 

2. Attach a two-minute recorded video introduction (Loom or similar). Tell us who you are, what you sell and why this role suits you. 

3. Confirm yes or no to each of the following to progress your application: 

a. SaaS or software sales experience? 

b. Based in the Philippines? 

c. Own work laptop or computer? 

d. Reliable primary internet plus a backup connection? 

e. Willing to work flexible hours to the customer's time zone? 



Shortlisted candidates move to a first-round interview, with final interviews held with the leadership team.

What We Offer

- Frequent 1-on-1 feedback Looms reviewing your work

- Direct mentorship on copywriting, marketing, and content strategy

- Access to copywriting courses, resources, examples, and training materials

- Constant feedback and opportunities to improve

How to Apply

s, or other marketing copy you've written

Personal Injury Settlement Specialist
description:
Prosper Injury Law is seeking a driven, detail-obsessed, and client-focused Settlement Specialist to join our growing Personal Injury team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the finish line of a PI case, where precision, negotiation skill, and client communication truly matter.

As a key member of our Settlements Department, you will own the entire post-settlement process, ensuring cases close efficiently, liens are negotiated strategically, and clients feel supported every step of the way. If you have experience navigating the complex world of lien resolution, negotiating reductions, preparing settlement packets, and managing distribution workflows, this role will give you the autonomy and structure to shine.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Settlement Coordination & Document Management

• Coordinate client review and execution of all settlement documents, including releases, authorizations, and closing statements.

• Ensure defense counsel/adjuster receives fully executed paperwork and issues settlement checks promptly.

• Draft all settlement-related documents, including settlement statements, closing documents, and attorney review packets.

Lien Negotiations & Adjudication

• Conduct comprehensive lien investigations and negotiate reductions with hospitals, medical providers, health insurers, and government agencies.

• Draft initial lien proposals, track responses, and aggressively follow up to secure the best outcomes for clients.

• Navigate Medicare, Medicaid, and private health insurance portals with confidence and accuracy.

Financial Management & Disbursement

• Prepare final settlement statements with strong attention to accuracy and compliance.

• Issue checks to lienholders, clients, referring counsel, and internal parties.

• Handle financial data entry, cost reviews, and settlement reconciliation.

Client Experience & Communication

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the post-settlement phase, setting expectations, providing updates, and ensuring clarity at every step.

• Maintain exceptional client relationships rooted in professionalism, empathy, and transparency.

Case Closure & Quality Control

• Perform final file audits to ensure all documentation is complete and compliant.

• Conduct file inventories and maintain organized, well-documented records.

What You Bring (Skills & Qualifications)

• Personal injury law firm experience with hands-on involvement in lien negotiations, settlements, or case resolution is highly preferred but not required.

• Exceptional negotiation skills with a results-driven mindset.

• Strong math and financial review skills; comfortable reconciling costs and calculating distributions.

• Superior attention to detail and organizational discipline.

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a client-service mindset.

• Familiarity with PI case management systems such as SmartAdvocate (or similar) highly preferred but not required.

• Bilingual (English/Spanish or English/Haitian Creole) highly preferred but not required.

Who You Are

You are someone who:

• Takes ownership of a file and sees it through to completion.

• Can communicate settlement complexities clearly and confidently to clients.

• Enjoys negotiation and knows how to advocate effectively.

• Values accuracy and organization as much as client satisfaction.

• Thrives in an environment where precision, speed, and empathy all matter.



General: 

• Full-time, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, M-F eastern time zone

• Proficient with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, and Outlook).

• Ability to manage a heavy workload in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong customer service skills.

Affiliate Partnerships Coordinator (Remote)

USD $1,000/month

Fully Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position



Do you enjoy building relationships, working with creators, and helping grow one of the fastest-growing marketing channels in e-commerce?



Ella Bella is an established hair tools and hair care brand with a strong presence on Amazon. As we continue expanding across TikTok Shop, Shopify, Walmart, and other platforms, we're looking for someone to help grow and manage our creator and affiliate partnerships.



Our main focus is TikTok Shop, but we're also open to building creator and affiliate partnerships across other platforms.



Affiliate marketing experience is a plus, but not required. We're more focused on finding someone who has excellent attention to detail, strong written communication skills, good judgment, and the ability to work independently.



We're looking for someone who reads instructions carefully, learns quickly, takes ownership of their work, and knows when to solve something independently versus when to stop and ask for clarification.



What You'll Do

• Identify and recruit high-quality creators and affiliates through personalized outreach across multiple platforms

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with creators and affiliates

• Guide partners through onboarding and provide ongoing support

• Follow up regularly to keep partnerships active and engaged

• Review creator profiles and performance to determine whether they meet our partnership criteria

• Track outreach, creator activity, and partnership progress accurately

• Analyze creator performance and identify opportunities to improve recruitment, engagement, and campaign results

• Support creator campaigns, competitions, and community initiatives

• Handle day-to-day creator and affiliate tasks independently while flagging unusual situations when needed

• Help improve our creator recruitment, outreach, and affiliate partnership programs



We're Looking for Someone Who Is

• Highly detail-oriented — you carefully read and follow instructions and don't skip important details

• A strong written communicator — you can communicate clearly and naturally with creators and tea
mbers

• Independent — once you've learned a process, you can handle recurring tasks without needing constant guidance

• Good at using judgment — you know when you can move forward on your own and when you should stop and ask before proceeding

• Proactive — if something doesn't look right, you investigate or flag it instead of simply continuing

• Organized — you keep records accurate and stay on top of multiple conversations, tasks, and follow-ups

• Quick to learn — you can understand new tools, processes, and feedback and apply what you've learned to future tasks

• Accountable — you take ownership of your work, learn from mistakes, and follow through on commitments

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly



Requirements

• Excellent written English

• Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail

• Excellent time management and organizational skills

• Ability to follow detailed written instructions accurately

• Ability to work independently

• Reliable computer and internet connection

• Available to work US Eastern Time business hours (night shift in the Philippines)



Previous experience in affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, influencer marketing, TikTok Shop, or e-commerce is an advantage, but not required.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Competitive salary

• Fully remote

• Stable, long-term opportunity

• Friendly and supportive international team

• Career growth opportunities

• Hands-on experience in affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, and e-commerce

• Opportunity to help shape and improve a rapidly growing creator program

• Work closely with our team and take ownership of projects that directly impact our creator partnerships



What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, you should be able to:

• Handle regular creator and affiliate tasks with increasing independence

• Read, understand, and follow processes accurately

• Know when to make a decision independently and when to ask for guidance

• Build strong relationships with creators and affiliates

• Recruit high-quality creator and affiliate partners

• Keep creator outreach and partnership records accurate and organized

• Apply feedback so the same issues don't continue to happen

• Help the team improve and scale our creator and affiliate partnerships



How to Apply

Please submit your resume.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a series of practical assessments designed to evaluate communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, and judgment.

description:

About QuietLab



We believe modern life breaks sleep — so we fix it, with science-backed, problem-solving sleep products that give people back their energy. We scaled to 8 figures fast, and now we're going to 9 even faster. We're building the most talked-about sleep brand in the world — a movement powered by great products and great marketing.



The Opportunity



Own the edit behind every high-converting ad we ship.



You'll join our top-tier video editing team and work closely with our creative strategists, turning scripts, footage, and briefs into high volumes of ads built to convert. You'll master cutting-edge editing tools, including AI-powered creation and editing tools like HeyGen, Runway, and Veo3, to maximize your output and turn performance feedback into your next cut. Every asset you create is measured and optimized, never sitting in a folder, so your ownership and impact are visible in a team scaling from 8 to 9 figures.



If you love fast, high-volume editing, thrive on direct feedback, and want your work measured and rewarded, this is your seat.



Responsibilities



Editing & Production:

Edit VSLs and short-form video ads (15 to 60 seconds) for Meta, Applovin, and YouTube

Take scripts, briefs, and raw creator content and turn them into ad-ready creatives

Add captions, overlays, pattern interrupts, sound effects, and native transitions to increase retention

Edit in a native, direct-response style built for how people actually watch on Meta, Applovin and YouTube



Creative Testing & Iteration:

Create multiple hook and intro variations for testing

Work with our creative strategist to iterate based on feedback and ad performance data

Bring fresh ideas for hooks, angles, and formats rather than only executing briefs as given



AI & Workflow:

Use AI tools (HeyGen, Runway, Veo3, and similar) to generate and enhance creatives

Continuously look for ways AI can speed up sourcing, editing, or QA



Organization & Compliance:

Ensure all content complies with creator usage rights and licensing before publishing

Manage and organize projects efficiently with minimal supervision

Stay aware of Meta ad compliance guidelines



Who You Are



Proven track record editing video ads for e-commerce brands (not cinematic or traditional film edits)

Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro; able to create overlays, captions, and simple motion graphics

Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, and audience retention

Ability to create edits that feel native to Meta, Applovin and YouTube

Familiar with AI content tools like HeyGen and Runway

You know how to source and select the right footage

Resourceful, proactive, and able to deliver fast, consistently

Thrive in high-energy, feedback-driven environments

No agencies, outsourcing, or part-time. Full-time role working directly with our in-house team



Bonus Points:

Experience with direct-response ads, health and wellness a plus

Familiarity with creative testing (hooks, angles, variations)

Ability to create simple motion graphics and animated callouts

Awareness of ad compliance guidelines for Meta



What Success Looks Like

Week 1: Understand our products, audience, content workflows, and brand voice. Create multiple hook and intro variations across platforms. 

Week 2: Deliver first batch of short-form ads and variations following our SOPs. 

Week 3: Take on a long-form sales video project. 

Week 4: Own end-to-end editing with minimal revisions, consistently hitting performance benchmarks.



Our Core Values

"Rules are for people who have no values."



Integrity: We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Trust is non-negotiable. 

Excellence: We aim for the top 1%. Good enough is never enough. 

High-Energy: We show up with passion and positivity in everything we do. 

Customer Centricity: We work from the customer backwards. 

Urgency: We move fast, not with haste but with control. The deadline is always ASAP. Simplicity: We challenge the status quo and strip the non-essential.



Hiring Process



Application on this link: 

Screening Call: quick fit check on background, tools, and availability

Paid Trial Task: a real exercise, show us how you edit

In-Depth Interview: craft, workflow, and decision-making

Offer Discussion

Onboarding

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. This isn't a role for someone who just follows a script; we need a problem-solver who understands the "why" behind Amazon’s rules and knows how to navigate them effectively. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.



Key Responsibilities

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly.



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.



Operational Support: General administrative tasks related to the Amazon storefront to ensure "everything is just handled."



The Ideal Candidate

The "Amazon Veteran": You’ve been inside Seller Central long enough to know that "The Rules" and "How things actually work" are often two different things.



Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.



English Fluency: Excellent written English is a must for both customer service and drafting persuasive appeals to Amazon.



Technical Requirements

Proven experience with Amazon Seller Central (specifically Account Health and Case Logs).



Experience handling "difficult" compliance or reinstatement issues is a major plus.



Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

title: QA Tester (Web + Backend) - Contract with Long-Term Potential
description:
We are a casino and gaming-focused web platform preparing to launch. 



We need a meticulous QA Tester to tear apart our product before it goes live. This is not a "click around and see if it looks okay" job. This is a deep, systematic hunt for broken buttons, dead links, modal failures, popup glitches, flow interruptions, backend-to-frontend communication breaks, and anything else that would make a real user lose trust in the product.



You will be testing three surfaces:



1. A pre-registration landing page (where users sign up before launch)

2. The main web application and its game lobby

3. An internal backoffice dashboard (admin tooling, CRM-adjacent systems)



For each surface, you are expected to test:

- Every button, link, and interactive element

- Every modal, popup, tooltip, and notification

- Every form, input, validation, and error state

- Complete user flows from start to finish (registration, navigation, game access, admin operations)

- Front-end to back-end communication (does the action you took actually do what it should server-side)

- Edge cases: mobile, desktop, different browsers, slow connections, broken states

- Anything that connects to or should feed into our CRM pipeline



Your primary output is structured QA reports. Each report should include:



- Clear title for each issue

- Steps to reproduce (numbered, exact)

- Expected behavior vs. actual behavior

- Screenshots or screen recordings where applicable

- Severity rating (Critical, High, Medium, Low)

- Environment details (browser, device, OS)



What We Need From You to Apply:



1. A short written introduction  explaining who you are and what kind of QA work you have done. Write this yourself. Do not paste a generated summary. If your introduction reads like it was written as AI SLOP, we will not read further.



2. A sample QA report from a previous project. This should be a real report you wrote for a real testing engagement, not a template. If you do not have a prior report, write one against any public website of your choice (pick one, test it for 15 minutes, and document what you find).



3. State your English fluency level explicitly (C1, C2, or Native).



What Gets You Disqualified Immediately:

- AI-generated applications. If your writing has the hallmarks of AI-generated text (generic filler, robotic phrasing, overuse of certain punctuation patterns), we stop reading. Write like a human.

- Applications with no sample report attached.

- Applications that do not state an English level.



About the Role:

This is a 4 to 6 week intensive contract with the strong possibility of ongoing work after launch. You will be added to our Slack workspace and work alongside the team directly. We want someone who can integrate, communicate, and flag problems without needing to be chased. If the engagement goes well, there is a clear path to an ongoing QA relationship as the product scales.



Skills Required:

- Manual QA testing (web applications)

- Bug report writing (structured, reproducible)

- Cross-browser testing

- Mobile web testing

- Basic understanding of front-end to back-end data flow

- Experience with any issue tracking tool (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, or similar)

description:
Lead Software Engineer (Full-Stack) — Remote, Philippines



*Company:* Archer Wealth · Sydney, Australia

*Type:* Full-time independent contractor · Fully remote (Philippines-based)

*Hours:* AEST overlap required (PH time is only 2 hours behind Sydney — near-full overlap)

*Compensation:* Php 85,000 - Php 110,000





The role



Archer Wealth is a Sydney-based private credit lender. Our entire technology platform — broker portal, credit workbench, warehouse reporting, loan management — has been built by the founder. It works, it's in production, and it now needs a lead engineer to take ownership of it so the founder can get out of the codebase and back to running the business. You'll be the first dedicated engineering hire, working directly with the founder, with a genuine path to owning the platform end to end.



About Archer Wealth



We're a non-bank lender originating first mortgage, second mortgage, bridging, development, commercial, and caveat loans through an accredited broker channel, funded through institutional warehouse facilities. Small team, real revenue, regulated industry, no bureaucracy. The tech you build moves real money and real loans.



What success looks like in 12 months



You've taken over day-to-day ownership of a multi-app production monorepo, shipped features across the broker portal and credit workbench without regressions, tightened our release and testing practices, and become the person the founder trusts to say "handled."



What you'll do



- Own feature development across a React 18 + Vite monorepo (broker portal, credit workbench, ops tooling, warehouse reporting)

- Build and maintain the Supabase (Postgres) data layer — schema migrations, RLS policies, PostgREST queries

- Maintain integrations: Salesforce (Flows/Apex webhooks), Azure AD auth, Azure Document Intelligence, Claude API document extraction

- Write disciplined, idempotent SQL migrations and respect existing conventions (we have strong opinions and a documented house style)

- Communicate in clear written English: async updates, Loom walkthroughs, honest estimates



What we're looking for



*Required*



- 5+ years full-stack experience with React and modern JavaScript

- Strong SQL/Postgres — you can design schemas and debug row-level security, not just call an ORM

- Experience owning production systems solo or in a very small team

- Excellent written English and a habit of proactive async communication

- Comfortable working within an established codebase's conventions rather than rewriting to your preferences



*Preferred*



- Supabase, Netlify, or Azure AD/Entra experience

- Fintech, lending, or other regulated-industry background

- Salesforce integration experience (Flows, Apex, REST)

- Experience with LLM/document-AI integrations



How to apply



 
 with your CV and a short note on a production system you've owned. Shortlisted candidates complete an online assessment, then a paid 1–2 week trial project.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
Channel Type: Faceless YouTube channel



Commitment: Full-time | 6 days/week | 8 hours/day (prompt responses expected during working hours)



Turnaround: Fast-paced with daily deadlines. Each video must be completed, submitted, and formally approved within the same day. Work is only considered finished once approval is granted and no further revisions are required. If videos are completed and approved ahead of schedule, the workday may conclude early; if approval is not achieved within scheduled hours, continued effort is required until the video is finalized and accepted.



Resources: Detailed VO scripts and reference videos will be provided for every single video



About the Role

We run a fast-growing faceless YouTube channel producing long-form, story-driven content on trending news. Each video is built around a professional voiceover script — your role is to add visual direction and bring it to life.

We're seeking a full-time video editor to independently source footage, craft engaging edits, and design high-impact thumbnails — all to a consistent daily standard. This is a long-term position with stable pay and strong growth potential.



What You'll Do



Edit 2 long-form videos daily (25-35 minutes each), synced precisely to provided voiceover scripts with a polished, broadcast-quality finish



Independently research, source, and organize a high volume of B-roll and footage (dozens to hundreds of clips per video).

Every single clip must be directly relevant to what the narrator is saying at that exact moment. No generic filler, no lazy stock footage. Public event clips, news interviews, archival material, paparazzi footage, and royalty-free assets must all be hunted down with patience, precision, and a researcher's mindset



Match footage tightly to the narration — when the script references a specific person, event, or moment, the visual on screen must reflect it. Viewers should feel the video was made for that story, not assembled from whatever was available

Keep engagement high with varied visuals — mix close-ups, reaction clips, text overlays, and relevant cutaways to prevent drop-off across the full 25–35 minute runtime



Add professional finishing elements: on-screen subtitles/captions, smooth transitions, background music, and cinematic pacing tuned for retention



Design 2 CTR-focused thumbnails daily — bold, emotionally charged, YouTube-native style with strong visual hierarchy

Maintain an organized shared asset library and meet all daily deadlines without follow-up

What You Need



Proven proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve



Strong thumbnail design skills using Photoshop or Canva



Strong research ability — patience to source precise and relevant footage for 25–35 minute scripts (finding the exact clip, not just a close enough one)



High attention to detail — visuals must match narration exactly. (e.g. If the narrator says "the garden party in 2018," the footage on screen should reflect that moment specifically, not a random garden party



B-roll sourcing experience — from stock libraries, YouTube archives, and public media

A reliable workstation with capable setup and fast internet for long form projects



Good English comprehension — all scripts and voiceovers are in English

A sharp sense of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention for news-style content



Judgement on footage — knowing when clips add emotional weight vs. noise



Full-time commitment — 6 days/week and 8 hours per day, delivering 2 complete videos + 2 thumbnails daily. Prompt responses expected during working hours.



Bonus Points

Previous experience editing news, current events, or royal/celebrity content

Familiarity with royalty-free asset platforms (Storyblocks, Pexels, Artgrid, etc.) and basic audio mixing

Understanding of YouTube CTR and retention best practices (hooks, pacing, visual variety)

Experience editing long-form content where viewer retention past the 50% mark is a real priority



How to Apply

Message me directly here, or
 with the subject line: YouTube Editor Application – [Your Name]

Please include:

Two examples of long-form videos you have edited (links preferred)

Two YouTube-style thumbnails you have designed

Your editing and design tools (software + hardware specs)

Your availability — earliest start date and preferred 8-hours working schedule

title: Intellectual Property Paralegal
description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Brand Protection Specialist to oversee the Company's

intellectual property (IP) protection and enforcement activities.



This role is responsible for leading and supporting the IP team, coordinating with internal

stakeholders, external partners and ensuring the effective management of IP enforcement,

portfolio administration, and case tracking activities.



Key Responsibilities:



IP Enforcement: Directly handling the enforcement of intellectual property rights on various

e-commerce platforms, with a strong focus on Amazon, including follow-up and coordination

with external parties to secure timely enforcement of IP claims, or provision of additional

materials.



IP Team Operational Support: Provide operational, administrative, and coordination

support for the day-to-day management and workload allocation of the Intellectual Property

(IP) Team, including maintaining records and reporting, and helping to ensure that IP

projects, enforcement activities, and strategic objectives are delivered efficiently and aligned

with business priorities.



IP Data Management: Assisting with the organisation and tracking of the company’s

growing IP portfolio, including asset organisation and management, so that we have swift

access to what we need, when we need it.



IP Communication: Working with the Head of IP to ensure all IP claim inquiries are

evaluated and addressed in a timely manner. This include coordination / document provision

to external partners as necessary, and aspects of case management/tracking as, and when

specific issues escalate.



IP R&D: Working with management to research protection and enforcement strategies on

new platforms, or via third parties, as well as testing, and implementing IP/brand protection

strategies and programs across retail platforms/markets.



Qualifications:



• A bachelor's degree or relevant diploma in law, or a post-secondary program with

law-related coursework

• A minimum of four years’ experience in a paralegal or similar role, including coverage

of IP/patent matters

• Proficiency in legal terminology and electronic databases, including, for example, the

USPTO's Trademark Electronic Search System (TESS) and other foreign equivalents

• Exceptional ability to perform research and keep track of deadlines

• Proven ability to take initiative and work independently, demonstrating a proactive

approach to tasks and projects

• Must have excellent recordkeeping and communication skills

• Familiarity with Amazon’s Brand Registry Tool is a strong plus

• Proficiency in G-Suite and Microsoft Office Tools (Word and Excel)

• Excellent English Communication Skills

title: AI/Integrations Specialist (N8n, Cloud Fare, Developer)
description:
# Senior Software Engineer – AI & Automation Platform



## About Herrman & Herrman



Herrman & Herrman is a high-volume personal injury law firm dedicated to using technology to improve client service, streamline operations, and empower our attorneys and staff. We are investing heavily in AI and automation and are looking for an experienced software engineer to help build the next generation of our firm's technology platform.



This is not a maintenance role—we are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, integrating systems, and building innovative solutions that will have a direct impact on how our firm operates.



---



# Position Overview



We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain an internal AI and automation platform that integrates our core business systems, modernizes reporting, and leverages AI to improve productivity across the firm.



This role will involve building custom integrations, automation workflows, reporting dashboards, and AI-powered tools that become part of our firm's daily operations.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys architecting solutions, working with APIs, and building products that solve real business problems.



---



# Primary Responsibilities



### AI Integration



* Integrate ChatGPT Enterprise with our internal systems.

* Develop AI-powered tools that allow attorneys and staff to securely query case information using natural language.

* Build AI workflows for case summaries, document analysis, drafting assistance, and operational automation.

* Identify additional opportunities to implement AI throughout the firm.



---



### Systems Integration



Develop and maintain integrations between our core platforms, including:



* Filevine

* Lead Docket

* Zoom Phone

* Microsoft 365

* Other cloud-based legal and business applications



Projects include:



* Zoom Phone ? Filevine recording integration

* Enhancing the existing Lead Docket ? Filevine integration to support two-way synchronization

* Eliminating duplicate data entry through automation

* Building API-based workflows between systems



---



### Reporting & Business Intelligence



Design and develop a modern reporting platform to replace our current reporting limitations.



Build dashboards that provide real-time visibility into:



* Attorney fees

* Total fees

* Settlements

* Demands sent

* Revenue

* Case pipeline

* Productivity

* Operational performance



Develop attorney KPI dashboards that provide meaningful performance metrics and operational insights for firm leadership.



---



### Workflow Automation



Identify repetitive manual processes and automate them wherever possible.



Examples include:



* Document processing

* Case updates

* Notifications

* Task creation

* Reporting

* Workflow management

* AI-assisted operational tools



---



# Required Skills



* Strong experience with Node.js and/or TypeScript

* Experience designing REST APIs and web services

* Experience integrating third-party APIs

* OAuth authentication

* Cloud platforms (Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure)

* SQL and data integration experience

* Experience designing scalable software architecture

* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills



---



# Preferred Qualifications



Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:



* OpenAI / ChatGPT Enterprise integrations

* Google Cloud Run

* Google Cloud Tasks

* Webhooks

* Workflow automation

* Business intelligence dashboards

* Data visualization

* Filevine API

* Legal technology platforms

* CRM or case management software integrations



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate enjoys building systems rather than simply maintaining them.



You should be someone who:



* Thinks like an architect

* Enjoys solving complex business problems with technology

* Can work independently

* Can recommend better approaches rather than simply following specifications

* Is excited about AI and automation

* Wants to build long-term solutions that scale



---



# Why Join Us?



This is an opportunity to build technology that will fundamentally change how an established law firm operates.



Rather than working on isolated projects, you'll help create a centralized platform that combines:



* Artificial Intelligence

* Workflow Automation

* Systems Integration

* Business Intelligence

* Operational Dashboards

* Custom Internal Applications



Your work will directly impact attorneys, staff, and leadership by reducing manual work, improving decision-making, and creating a more intelligent, data-driven organization.



We're looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term technology partner as we continue expanding AI and automation throughout the firm.
